en.concept: Place names and geographic proper nouns
en.description: The main responses are to the proper place names Brisbane and London: the former is concentrated in Australia-related texts, while the latter appears in academic addresses, email time zones, and legal company names. Other Australian locations, institution names, and email time formats also activate.

patterns.name: Brisbane place name

en.description: The most prominent triggers are the place name Brisbane (1–6) and London (7–10); there are also Australian, Queensland, and cricket-related words, as well as sporadic activations for date and time-zone formats, word-internal fragments, and legal terminology.

patterns.name: Brisbane place name
patterns.context: Appears as a place name in sentences about people’s positions, schools, sports events, or local Australian history; it is often preceded by the preposition “in” or a definite article.

patterns.name: London place name
patterns.context: Appears as a place name in institutional addresses, time-zone schedules, or legal case names; contexts respectively concern a research institution’s location, London time, and company names.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, business emails, legal text

patterns.name: Australia- and cricket-related words
patterns.context: Appears in accounts of Australian cricket events, players’ careers, or state-level competitions; “crick” is a word-internal fragment of words such as “cricketers”.

patterns.name: Miscellaneous word-internal fragments
patterns.context: These activations are scattered inside words or proper nouns, or correspond to terms in legal text; apart from the local semantics of the sentence, no shared trigger is apparent.
patterns.domain: Philosophical commentary, academic affiliations, legal text, and other

patterns.name: Date and time-zone formats
patterns.context: Appears in itinerary schedules containing dates, times, and time zones.

0_50.description: 最显著的触发是地名 Brisbane（1–6）与 London（7–10）；另有澳大利亚、昆士兰及板球词汇，以及零散的日期时区、词内片段和法律术语激活。

en.description: All examples activate on the place name Brisbane or Wellington: the former appears in Australia-related texts, while the latter appears in bibliographies, US bridge history, and biographies; the shared feature is the place-name string.

patterns.name: Brisbane place name
patterns.context: The city of Brisbane in Queensland, Australia, appears near locations, institutions, or event names; no fixed syntactic position is required.
patterns.domain: Australian biographies, education, sports, and social-history encyclopedia texts; the first passage is a history of activities in a philosophical commentary context.

patterns.name: Wellington place name
patterns.context: The place name Wellington appears in examples concerning New Zealand publication information, a bridge in Alabama, US, and local biographies; it does not refer to the same place in all cases.

en.description: All fragments show strong activation on London; it appears across genres, syntax, and topics. Its semantic role varies and includes a city, place of publication, time-zone location, and component of a company name.

patterns.name: London place name

patterns.name: Bibliographic or publication format for London

patterns.name: London in regional, resident, or political narratives

en.description: The core trigger word is weaken: it means reducing an object's strength, function, connection, influence, or ability; in storm reports, it also refers to a cyclone weakening or being downgraded. The objects and causes vary across domains.

patterns.name: Cause to weaken (general use)
patterns.context: The verb means making an ability, effect, relationship, or structure weaker. The object and cause vary by domain; examples include both abstract effects and biological signaling relationships.
patterns.domain: Philosophical discourse, medicine, biology, politics and institutions, humanities and history, fitness, and patent texts

patterns.name: Storm weakening
patterns.context: A tropical cyclone or storm loses intensity or is downgraded after landfall or under conditions such as wind shear.

0_125.description: 核心触发词是 weaken：表示使对象的强度、功能、联系、影响或能力降低；在风暴报道中也指气旋强度减弱、等级下降。对象和原因跨领域变化。

patterns.name: 使减弱、削弱（一般用法）
patterns.context: 动词表示使某种能力、作用、关系或结构变弱，宾语及原因随领域而变化；包括抽象影响，也包括生物信号关系。
patterns.domain: 哲学论述、医学、生物学、政治与机构、人文史、健身及专利文本

patterns.name: 风暴减弱
patterns.context: 热带气旋或风暴在登陆、遇到风切变等条件后，强度降低或降级。

en.description: Activation is almost always triggered by weaken, covering the weakening of syntactic requirements, cell adhesion, storms, groups, institutions, muscles, damping, signaling relationships, and cell junctions; one passage also uses the synonym undermine.

patterns.name: Lexical trigger weaken
patterns.context: The word directly means to weaken or diminish, or to make a function, connection, or object weaker; the trigger does not depend on specific syntax or domain.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English expository texts, academic papers, historical and news texts

patterns.name: Synonymous expression for weaken
patterns.context: A synonymous verb describes weakening or damaging the power of an institution or mechanism; however, the main marker in the passage is the later «weaken»10.

0_125.description: 激活几乎都由 weaken 触发，涵盖句法需求、细胞黏附、风暴、群体、制度、肌肉、阻尼、信号关系及细胞连接的减弱；另在一段出现近义词 undermine。

patterns.name: weaken 的词汇触发
patterns.context: 该词直接表示削弱、减弱或使某种功能、联系、对象变弱；触发不依赖特定句法或领域。

en.description: All snippets activate on the verb “weaken,” meaning to make an object weaker, diminish its function or relationship, or become weaker. Objects range across syntactic requirements, cell adhesion, storms, political influence, institutional mechanisms, muscle groups, damping functions, predictive relationships, and cell junctions.

patterns.name: Weaken, diminish, or impair a function/relationship
patterns.context: “Weaken” is used as a verb followed by the object being weakened; it may refer to a storm, force, effect, relationship, or structure, without requiring a specific sentence pattern.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain expository prose, including philosophy, medicine, meteorology, history, politics, fitness, patents, and biomedicine

en.description: All passages activate on weaken: the word describes the weakening of an object's effect, intensity, structure, or relationship. The trigger semantics are stable, while the objects and domains vary widely.

patterns.name: Weaken or diminish an effect or relationship

patterns.context: 出现在建筑名称、地址或机构地址中；触发点是单词 Building，前后常有专名、楼名或地址信息。
patterns.domain: 学术论文地址、论文正文、经济日历、法律引文

patterns.name: 学术机构地址
patterns.context: 建筑词嵌在大学、研究所或院系的作者地址中，通常邻接地点、邮编或单位名称。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 作者单位与通讯地址

patterns.name: 正文中沿用建筑隐喻或短语
patterns.context: 短语“Building on”表示在既有结果或工作基础上继续推进，并非实体建筑地址。

patterns.name: 建筑许可类别
patterns.context: 出现在经济日历的指标列表中，Building 修饰 permits，指建筑许可。

patterns.name: 机构名称中的建筑基金
patterns.context: Building 是法律案件所涉医院基金名称的一部分，而非地址。

en.description: All snippets show the strongest activation on the token blessing; its modifiers and contexts vary, covering blessings, religious ceremonies or approval, as well as figurative uses such as “a blessing in disguise.”

patterns.name: Core word blessing
patterns.context: The target word blessing itself triggers across different syntactic and semantic contexts, such as “mixed blessing,” “a blessing,” “with thy blessing,” “bridal blessing,” “patriarchal blessing,” “organisation’s blessing,” and “an amazing blessing”.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; news, code comments, literature, encyclopedias, personal experiences, etc.

0_230.description: 所有片段均在 token blessing 上出现最强激活；其修饰语及语境多样，涵盖祝福、宗教仪式或许可，也包括“因祸得福”等比喻用法。

patterns.name: 核心词 blessing
patterns.context: 目标词 blessing 本身在各种句法和语义环境中触发：如“mixed blessing”“a blessing”“with thy blessing”“bridal blessing”“patriarchal blessing”“organisation’s blessing”“an amazing blessing”。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；新闻、代码注释、文学、百科、个人经历等

en.description: All snippets activate strongly on the word blessing. It covers general good fortune and favors and their common collocations, as well as blessings in weddings or religious ceremonies; activation seems driven by the word itself, while surrounding context determines the specific sense.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “a blessing”
patterns.context: Generally refers to something as a blessing, good fortune, or favor; also includes variants such as “mixed blessing” and “blessing in disguise”.
patterns.domain: Prose, reviews, web text, and conversation

patterns.name: Blessings in religious ceremonies
patterns.context: Refers to specific religious ceremonies or blessings in religious texts, such as bridal or patriarchal blessings.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic biographies, religion, and archival descriptions

0_230.description: 所有片段都在 blessing 一词处强烈激活。它涵盖一般的幸事、恩惠及其常见搭配，也涵盖婚礼或宗教仪式中的祝福；激活似乎由该词本身主导，周围语境决定具体义项。

patterns.name: 短语固定搭配“a blessing”
patterns.context: 泛指某事物是祝福、幸事或恩惠；也包括“mixed blessing”“blessing in disguise”等变体
patterns.domain: 散文、评论、网页文本及口语

patterns.name: 宗教仪式中的祝福
patterns.context: 指婚礼祝福或宗主教祝福等具体宗教仪式、宗教文献中的祝福
patterns.domain: 百科传记、宗教与档案说明

en.description: All snippets contain the activated contiguous letter substring “RM”, but its referent varies by domain: abbreviations in physics, sports, and health research; table fields, code identifiers, or comments; and a substring within hash strings.

patterns.name: RM in the abbreviation RMF
patterns.context: Appears in “relativistic mean field (RMF) theory,” where RM is part of a physics term abbreviation.

patterns.name: RM in the abbreviation Replica Method
patterns.context: RM is used in a title or body text as an abbreviation for Replica Method, often adjacent to “replica method”.

patterns.name: RM in the abbreviation Rotation Measure
patterns.context: RM refers to rotation measure in astrophysics, involving nebulae, the Galactic background, and Faraday rotation.

patterns.name: RM in the abbreviation Repetition Maximum
patterns.context: Appears in “Repetition Maximum” and RM value labels, referring to an exercise-training load metric.
patterns.domain: Sports science papers and personal blogs

patterns.name: RM field in a table cell
patterns.context: Appears as HTML table-cell content or a field label, adjacent to markup tags.

patterns.name: RM substring in an identifier
patterns.context: Embedded in the camel-case program identifier “signalRMessages,” forming an intra-word substring.

patterns.name: RM in the abbreviation Recovery Management
patterns.context: Appears in the abbreviation for “Recovery Management Checkups (RMCs)”.
patterns.domain: Addiction and social health research papers

patterns.name: RM substring in a comment
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of “RM: hack” in a code comment, possibly as an abbreviation or comment label.

patterns.name: RM substring in a checksum string
patterns.context: Embedded in a JSON dependency-integrity hash string, not functioning as an independent word or clear abbreviation.

0_230.description: 所有片段都包含激活的连续字母子串“RM”，但其所指因领域而异：物理、运动、健康研究中的缩写，表格字段、代码标识符或注释，以及哈希字符串内部子串。

patterns.name: RMF缩写中的RM
patterns.context: 出现在“relativistic mean field (RMF) theory”中，RM是物理术语缩写的一部分。

patterns.name: Replica Method缩写中的RM
patterns.context: 标题或正文中将 RM 用作 Replica Method 的缩写，常与“replica method”相邻。

patterns.name: Rotation Measure缩写中的RM
patterns.context: RM 指天体物理中的 rotation measure，涉及星云、银河背景及 Faraday rotation。

patterns.name: Repetition Maximum缩写中的RM
patterns.context: 出现在“Repetition Maximum”及 RM 数值标记中，表示运动训练负荷指标。
patterns.domain: 运动科学论文及个人博客

patterns.name: 表格单元格中的RM字段
patterns.context: 作为HTML表格单元格内容或字段标签出现，邻接标记语言标签。

patterns.name: 标识符中的RM子串
patterns.context: 嵌在驼峰式程序标识符“signalRMessages”中，形成词内子串。

patterns.name: Recovery Management缩写中的RM
patterns.context: 出现在“Recovery Management Checkups (RMCs)”的缩写中。
patterns.domain: 成瘾与社会健康研究论文

patterns.name: 注释中的RM子串
patterns.context: 作为代码注释中“RM: hack”的开头，可能是缩写或注释标签。

patterns.name: 校验字符串中的RM子串
patterns.context: 嵌在JSON依赖完整性哈希字符串中，不表现为独立词或明确缩写。

en.concept: Specific word forms and theorem markers
en.description: Activation concentrates on two salient markers: Lemma 10 in mathematical text (alongside other theorem-environment markers), and the word form communicated across different writing styles. Other mathematical terms, publication information, and subword fragments show weak and sporadic co-occurrence, making them difficult to group under a single trigger.

patterns.name: Lemma number marker
patterns.context: In a theorem environment or cross-reference, the number 10 follows the name of a mathematical statement; especially prominent in snippets 1, 2, 5, and 6.

patterns.name: communicated word form
patterns.context: The word means to convey, inform, or submit information, followed by to, in, etc.; surrounding meanings and sentence structures vary.
patterns.domain: Legal decisions, literary narration, history-of-science texts

patterns.name: Local triggers in mathematical texts
patterns.context: Mathematics papers discuss isomorphisms, fiber products, morphisms, and lemmas, but do not all contain an explicit Lemma 10 marker.

patterns.name: Mathematical analysis terminology
patterns.context: Discusses SGD error bounds and objective-function conditions; also contains theorem/lemma markers.

patterns.name: Isolated subword fragments and publication information
patterns.context: Conference extended abstracts and journal special-issue publication information; no clear Lemma 10 or communicated trigger word is present.

patterns.name: Graph-theoretic construction phrasing
patterns.context: Describes adjacency relations between vertices and sets U and W; this passage can be explained by the Lemma 10 marker, with no reliable trigger independent of that marker.

patterns.name: Names and other sporadic subword fragments
patterns.context: Sporadic subword activations in authors, paper titles, and abstracts, showing no stable independent semantic pattern.

0_230.description: 激活集中在两类醒目标记：数学文本里的 Lemma 10（并伴随其他定理环境标记），以及不同文体中词形 communicated。其余数学术语、出版信息和词片段呈弱而零散的共现，难以归为同一触发。

patterns.name: Lemma 编号标记
patterns.context: 定理环境或交叉引用中，数学陈述名称后紧跟编号 10；第 1、2、5、6 段尤为明显
patterns.domain: 数学论文、形式化定理标记

patterns.name: communicated 词形
patterns.context: 该词用于表示传达、告知或提交信息，后接 to、in 等；周围语义和句式各异
patterns.domain: 法律判决、文学叙述、科学史文本

patterns.name: 数学文本中的局部触发
patterns.context: 数学论文叙述同构、纤维积、态射与引理等内容，但不都出现显式的 Lemma 10 标记

patterns.name: 数学分析术语
patterns.context: 讨论 SGD 误差界与目标函数条件；同时含有定理/引理标记

patterns.name: 孤立的词片段与出版信息
patterns.context: 会议扩展摘要及期刊专刊出版信息；未见明确的 Lemma 10 或 communicated 触发词

patterns.name: 图论构造句式
patterns.context: 描述顶点与集合 U、W 的邻接关系；本段可由 Lemma 10 标记解释，未见独立于该标记的可靠触发

patterns.name: 人名及其他零散词片段
patterns.context: 作者、论文标题及摘要中的零散子词激活，未显示稳定的独立语义模式

en.concept: undefined in code and its contexts
en.description: Primarily responds to the literal undefined in code and contexts involving comparisons and type checks; it also responds to code indentation and sporadic JavaScript syntax fragments. CMake linker errors, questions about interface text, and documentation tokens also appear.

patterns.name: undefined literal and checks
patterns.context: In JavaScript code, undefined appears as a string, a type-check result, or part of a condition, usually surrounded by parentheses, comparison operators, or return/if.
patterns.domain: GitHub source code and StackExchange programming-question code

patterns.name: Indentation spaces and code formatting
patterns.context: Spaces appear at the beginning of code lines or between statements, reflecting indentation or layout; common in JavaScript snippets.
patterns.domain: GitHub source code and StackExchange code snippets

patterns.name: JavaScript syntax and identifier fragments
patterns.context: These code tokens appear in contexts such as variable assignment, function definitions, type checks, library calls, or regular expressions; activations are scattered and not all directly related to undefined checks.
patterns.domain: JavaScript source code, documentation examples, and programming questions

patterns.name: CMake build configuration and linker errors
patterns.context: CMake commands, variables, and build output appear in the same passage; undefined appears in linker error text rather than JavaScript type-checking code.

patterns.name: Natural-language question about interface text
patterns.context: The questioner asks how to remove text displayed in autocomplete; the word is a string shown in the interface, not a type check in code.

patterns.name: Formatting markers and local documentation tokens
patterns.context: Words appear in comments, JSDoc parameter descriptions, URLs, or code-formatting markers; activation is weaker and lacks a shared semantic trigger.
patterns.domain: GitHub comments, documentation, and formatted code

0_230.concept: 代码中的 undefined 及其上下文
0_230.description: 主要对代码中的 undefined 字面量及其比较、类型检查语境响应，也响应代码缩进和零散 JavaScript 语法片段；另见 CMake 链接错误、界面文字提问及文档 token。

patterns.name: undefined 字面量及其检查
patterns.trigger: «undefined»10；常与 typeof、!=、==、!== 或条件判断相邻
patterns.context: JavaScript 代码中将 undefined 作为字符串、类型检查结果或条件的一部分，周围通常有括号、比较运算符或 return/if。
patterns.domain: Github 源码与 StackExchange 编程问答代码

patterns.name: 缩进空格与代码格式
patterns.context: 空格出现在代码行首或语句之间，体现缩进或排版；多见于 JavaScript 代码片段。
patterns.domain: Github 源码与 StackExchange 代码片段

patterns.name: JavaScript 语法及标识符片段
patterns.context: 这些代码 token 出现在变量赋值、函数定义、类型判断、库调用或正则表达式等语境；激活点分散，不都与 undefined 检查直接相关。
patterns.domain: JavaScript 源码、文档示例与编程问答

patterns.name: CMake 构建配置与链接错误
patterns.context: CMake 命令、变量及构建输出出现在同一段；undefined 出现在链接器错误文本中，而非 JavaScript 的类型检查代码。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 上的 C++/CMake 构建问答

patterns.name: 自然语言中的界面文字问题
patterns.trigger: «undefined»10 出现在引号中的显示文本「undefined」
patterns.context: 提问者询问如何移除自动补全中显示的文字；该词是界面上出现的字符串，不是代码中的类型检查。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 自然语言编程问答

patterns.name: 格式标记与局部文档 token
patterns.context: 词语出现在注释、JSDoc 参数说明、URL 或代码格式标记中；激活较弱且缺少共同的语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: Github 注释、文档与格式化代码

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to “stranded” in hyphenated compounds: it describes the single- or double-stranded state of nucleic acids or the strand count of protein β-sheets; it also appears in “stranded costs” in energy emails.

patterns.name: Strand-count descriptions in nucleic acids
patterns.context: “stranded” appears in hyphenated compounds describing the strand state of RNA, DNA, viruses, or oligonucleotides; modifiers may include double or single.
patterns.domain: Molecular biology, virology, and biomedical papers

patterns.name: Strand-count descriptions in protein structures
patterns.context: “stranded” describes the number of strands in a β-sheet, appearing in descriptions of protein structures or domains.

patterns.name: “stranded costs” in energy contexts
patterns.context: “stranded” modifies costs, referring to costs already paid or stranded by electric utilities; this is not the biological use referring to strand structure.

0_230.description: 主要对连字符复合词中的“stranded”强烈响应：它描述核酸的单链/双链或蛋白β折叠的链数；另在能源邮件中出现“stranded costs”。

patterns.name: 核酸中的链数描述
patterns.context: “stranded”出现在连字符复合词中，描述 RNA、DNA、病毒或寡核苷酸的链状态；修饰词可为 double 或 single。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、病毒学及生物医学论文

patterns.name: 蛋白结构中的链数描述
patterns.context: “stranded”描述 β-sheet 中链的数目，出现在蛋白质结构或结构域的说明中。
patterns.domain: 蛋白质结构与生物化学论文

patterns.name: 能源语境中的 stranded costs
patterns.context: “stranded”修饰成本，指电力公司已支付或搁浅的成本；不是生物学中的链结构用法。

en.description: Activation falls mainly on tables/table and on tables in compound identifiers, links, or the phrase “round tables”; far also activates strongly in “So far” in a medical paper.

patterns.name: Phrase-final word in a medical article
patterns.context: In an academic sentence, means “to date” and is followed by a statement about progress in lncRNA research; strong activation falls on far in the phrase.

patterns.name: tables in code and identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in code, paths, identifiers, comments, or configuration text, as a plural word, capitalization variant, or part of a compound name.

patterns.name: Instruction tables documentation link
patterns.context: A PDF link to processor instruction information; the same passage also contains words such as optim and instruction.

patterns.name: Round tables as an event format
patterns.context: Listed alongside conference activities such as workshops, debates, poster presentations, and networking; refers to roundtable discussions.

0_230.description: 激活主要落在 tables/table 及其复合标识符、链接或“round tables”短语中的 tables；另在医学论文的“So far”中对 far 强烈激活。

patterns.name: 医学文章中的末尾词片段
patterns.context: 学术句子中表示“到目前为止”，后接关于 lncRNA 研究进展的陈述；高激活落在短语中的 far。

patterns.name: 代码与标识符中的 tables
patterns.context: 出现在代码、路径、标识符、注释或配置文本中，可为复数词、大小写变体或复合名称的一部分。

patterns.name: instruction tables 文档链接
patterns.context: 指向处理器指令信息的 PDF 链接；同段另有 optim、instruction 等词。

patterns.name: round tables 活动形式
patterns.context: 与研讨会、辩论、海报展示、交流等会议活动并列，指圆桌讨论。

en.description: Activations cluster on far: they include so far (to date), far-IR, the distance sense of far in far away/from, and far in the construction as far as…is concerned.

patterns.name: far in the phrase so far
patterns.context: In academic discussion, means “to date”; often appears at the beginning or within a sentence. Paragraph 1 has “so far has not been used”; paragraphs 2, 4, 6, and 8 have “So/so far”.

patterns.name: far with a long-distance meaning
patterns.context: Far modifies a noun or combines with away/from to express far-infrared, spatial distance, or being far from a state; it does not mean “to date”.

patterns.name: Fixed construction as far as
patterns.context: Forms a topic-limiting construction with as…as…concerned, meaning “with regard to”.

0_230.description: 激活集中于 far：既包括 so far（迄今为止），也包括 far-IR、far away/from 的距离义，以及 as far as…is concerned 结构中的 far。

patterns.name: 短语 so far 的 far
patterns.context: 学术论述中表示“迄今为止”，常见于句首或句中；第 1 段为 “so far has not been used”，第 2、4、6、8 段为 “So/so far”。

patterns.name: 远距离含义的 far
patterns.context: far 修饰名词或与 away/from 搭配，表达远红外、空间距离或与某状态相距甚远；并非表示“迄今为止”。
patterns.domain: 天体物理、物理学及数学论文

patterns.name: as far as 固定结构
patterns.trigger: «far»10，处于 “As far as the - relation is concerned”
patterns.context: 与 as…as…concerned 构成话题限定结构，意为“就……而言”。
patterns.domain: 学术论文中的论述性表达

en.description: Activations cluster on the word form far: they include so far (“to date”), the far-IR band, the spatial-distance sense of far, and the fixed collocation as far as; the common trigger is far.

patterns.name: Fixed collocation far + so far
patterns.context: Appears in “so far”, meaning “to date”; often follows a period or comma and precedes research progress, unresolved problems, or interim conclusions.

patterns.name: far-IR compound
patterns.context: Part of the name of an infrared band, contrasted with mid-/near-IR or listed alongside other observational bands.

patterns.name: Spatial-distance sense of far
patterns.context: Expresses physical distance or figuratively describes being far from a solution in terms of spatial distance.

patterns.name: Fixed collocation as far as
patterns.context: Introduces the topic delimiting the scope of discussion, followed by “the - relation is concerned”.

0_230.description: 激活集中于 far 的词形：既包括 so far“迄今为止”，也包括 far-IR 波段、空间距离义 far，以及 as far as 固定搭配；共同触发点是 far。

patterns.name: far + so far 固定搭配
patterns.trigger: «far»10；部分段落中为«So»7« far»10 或 «so»5« far»10
patterns.context: 出现在“so far”中，表示“迄今为止”；前面常有句号或逗号，后接研究进展、尚未解决的问题或阶段性结论。

patterns.name: far-IR 复合词
patterns.context: 作为红外波段名称的一部分，与 mid-/near-IR 对照，或与其他观测波段并列。

patterns.name: 空间距离意义的 far
patterns.context: 表示物理距离遥远，或以空间距离作比喻描述距离某个解答很远。

patterns.name: as far as 固定搭配
patterns.context: 引出限定讨论范围的话题，后接“the - relation is concerned”。
patterns.domain: 天文学论文中的论述性表达

en.concept: String fragments and multilingual word forms
en.description: Activations mainly correspond to Spanish sí, English Far (especially Faraday, also Far East), and Czech character fragments with diacritics; they span languages and fields, with no unified semantics evident.

patterns.name: Spanish sí
patterns.context: In Spanish sentences, appears as an affirmative adverb (“yes/indeed”) or reflexive pronoun (“oneself”); spaces or emphatic constructions are common nearby.

patterns.name: Far string
patterns.context: The capitalized form Far appears in English text, mainly at the beginning of Faraday; it also occurs in the place name Far East. Some instances occur at different word boundaries or in markers.
patterns.domain: Physics and astronomy papers, mathematics papers, news emails

patterns.name: Czech fragment with diacritics
patterns.context: In Czech text, activation falls on characters with diacritics or fragments within words; this example includes content such as letištní síť.

0_230.concept: 字符串片段与多语种词形
0_230.description: 激活主要对应西语 sí、英语 Far（尤其 Faraday，也见 Far East），另有捷克语带变音符号的字符片段；跨语种、跨领域，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: 西班牙语中的 sí
patterns.context: 西班牙语句子中作为肯定副词（“是/确实”）或反身代词（“自己”）出现；附近常见空格或强调结构。

patterns.name: Far 字符串
patterns.context: 英语文本中出现大小写形式 Far，主要是 Faraday 的词首；也有 Far-East 地名中的 Far。若干实例位于不同词边界或标记中。
patterns.domain: 物理与天文学论文、数学论文、新闻邮件

patterns.name: 捷克语带变音符号的片段
patterns.context: 捷克语文本中，激活落在带变音符号的字符或词内片段；本例包含 letištní síť 等内容。

en.description: Strong activations cluster on the character fragment far: an in-word fragment in Swedish fortfarande, several Far- names or surnames, and English so-far; other trigger positions may also be mere orthographic matches.

patterns.name: Swedish adverb fortfar-
patterns.context: Occurs within the Swedish word «fortfarande», typically immediately following the prefix «fort»; the word means “still”.

patterns.name: Farah/Farak name or surname fragment

patterns.domain: Proper nouns, place names, common words, and internal word fragments across domains

en.description: The most consistent signal is the Dou substring, found in words such as Douma, Douala, Doukas, and Douanier; there are also a few activations on adjacent suffixes and name, proper-noun, and common-word fragments across genres, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Name fragments

patterns.name: Poetic vocabulary and publisher name

patterns.name: Name fragments in lists

patterns.domain: Github 上的语言代码或名称列表

patterns.name: 物理论文中的 wi 序列
patterns.context: 出现于「Jozwiak」姓名的片段中；可能只是姓名拼写，局部证据有限。

en.description: All passages mark accompanies; it means that something accompanies or comes with something else, often in relative clauses. Several passages come from a fixed phrase in the Eclipse license; two other marked spans fall within Intel and itself.

patterns.name: accompanies as a verb
patterns.context: The word is a predicate or a verb in a relative clause, meaning that something accompanies or comes with another object; most examples are preceded by that/which and followed by an object.
patterns.domain: Software licenses, technical papers, emails, patents, and narrative texts

patterns.name: Fixed wording in a license
patterns.context: After a copyright notice, the text states that the program and its accompanying materials are distributed under the Eclipse Public License; accompanies occurs in a fixed license phrase.
patterns.domain: Github source-code copyright and license notices

patterns.name: Spelling-fragment coincidence
patterns.context: The marked activation falls on an in-word fragment of Intellectual, rather than on an independent occurrence of accompanies; the local context is a copyright notice.

patterns.name: In-word fragment coincidence
patterns.context: The mark covers the character fragment its in itself; the sentence discusses whether operating-system components are provided with an executable file.

0_1561.description: 所有段都标记 accompanies；它表示某物伴随、附带另一物，常见于关系从句。多段来自 Eclipse 许可证固定句式；另有两处标记落在 Intel、itself 的词内片段。

patterns.name: accompanies 作动词
patterns.context: 该词作为谓语或关系从句中的动词，表示某物随同、伴随或附带另一对象；多数例子前面有 that/which，后接宾语。
patterns.domain: 软件许可证、技术论文、邮件、专利及叙事文本

patterns.name: 许可证中的固定措辞
patterns.context: 版权声明之后，描述程序及其配套材料按 Eclipse Public License 发布；accompanies 位于许可证固定句式中。
patterns.domain: Github 源码版权与许可证声明

patterns.name: 拼写片段巧合
patterns.context: 激活标记落在 Intellectual 的词内片段，而不是独立的 accompanies；局部上下文为版权声明。

patterns.name: 词内片段巧合
patterns.context: 标记覆盖 itself 中的 its 字符片段，所在句讨论操作系统组件是否随可执行文件一同提供。

en.description: All segments activate on the same word form, “accompanies”: indicating that something appears with, accompanies, or is attended by something else. Contexts include licenses, software components, academic changes, market phenomena, people, and email files.

patterns.name: “accompanies” in license text
patterns.context: In the Eclipse Public License copyright notice, “which accompanies” means that the license is distributed with the software; “accompanies” is the core activation, often preceded by “program and the accompanying materials”.

patterns.name: Accompanying changes, variables, or files in technical or academic contexts
patterns.context: Describes a variable, system component, or change that appears at the same time as, or occurs alongside, something else.

patterns.name: Abstract phenomena or people accompanying others
patterns.context: Refers respectively to market power accompanied by limited access and to a person accompanying another person; the subject may be an abstract phenomenon or a specific person.

patterns.name: Notes about accompanying files or items
patterns.context: States that files are provided along with a batch of emails.

0_1561.description: 所有段均激活于同一词形“accompanies”：表示某物随另一物出现、附随或陪同。语境涵盖许可证、软件组件、学术变化、市场现象、人物和邮件文件。

patterns.name: 许可证文本中的 accompanies
patterns.context: Eclipse 公共许可证版权声明中，“which accompanies”指许可证随软件发行；“accompanies”是激活核心，前文常有“program and the accompanying materials”。
patterns.domain: Github 软件许可证/版权声明

patterns.name: 技术或学术语境中的伴随变化、变量或文件
patterns.trigger: “the novel Lagrange multiplier λ accompanies”“that component itself accompanies the executable”“correlation changes accompanies all gain changes”中的“accompanies”
patterns.context: 描述某变量、系统组件或一种变化与另一事物同时出现或随其发生。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、软件许可条款

patterns.name: 抽象或人物随行
patterns.context: 分别指市场权力伴随有限准入，以及人物陪同另一人物；主语可为抽象现象或具体人物。

patterns.name: 文件或物品附随说明
patterns.trigger: “A statement accompanies each batch of mail”中的“accompanies”
patterns.context: 说明文件随一批邮件一同提供。

en.concept: Specific word forms and document structure
en.description: Activation is concentrated on two English word forms: “Supporting” in titles or academic citations, and “participating” meaning taking part in legal contexts.

patterns.name: Supporting in titles
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a title or section heading, followed by a noun phrase, such as “mobility and providing flexibility” or “Actress”.
patterns.domain: News, reviews, or academic article title structure

patterns.name: Supporting Information citation
patterns.context: Appears in the body of a paper as the name of supplementary material, often accompanied by “see” and a link or section reference.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, especially chemistry or biomedical literature

patterns.name: participating and variants
patterns.context: Means taking part in a project, activity, agreement, or interview; used as a participle or adjective in legal texts.
patterns.domain: Legal judgments, administrative and project descriptions

0_1561.description: 激活集中于两类英文词形：标题或学术引用中的“Supporting”，以及法律语境中表示参与的“participating”。

patterns.name: Supporting 标题
patterns.context: 作为标题或小节标题开头，后接名词短语，如 “mobility and providing flexibility” 或 “Actress”。
patterns.domain: 新闻、评论或学术文章的标题结构

patterns.name: Supporting Information 引用
patterns.context: 出现在论文正文中，作为补充材料的名称，常伴随 “see” 及链接或章节引用。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，尤其是化学或生物医学文献

patterns.name: participating 及其变体
patterns.context: 表示参与某项目、活动、协议或访谈；在法律文本中作分词或形容词使用。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、行政及项目描述

en.description: Primarily activates on “Supporting” at the beginning of sentences or titles, and on the stem “glomer” in biomedical kidney contexts; there are also activations on “see” when citing supplementary material and on several sporadic subword fragments that are difficult to group into a common pattern.

patterns.name: “Supporting” section headings
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a title or section heading; subsequent content varies across the corpus. Title-style capitalization and line breaks are common.
patterns.domain: Web articles, research papers, entertainment reviews, encyclopedias

patterns.name: Glomerulus-related medical terms
patterns.context: Embedded in terms related to kidney disease or histology, typically co-occurring with nephropathy classifications, glomerular staining, or disease descriptions.

patterns.name: Research citations and supplementary-material labels
patterns.context: Points to supplementary information in paper methods or figure captions, often accompanied by links, figure references, and descriptions of chemical experiments.
patterns.domain: Research papers and their web transcriptions

patterns.name: Other sporadic subword-fragment activations
patterns.context: These subword fragments occur in different contexts across segments, with no stable shared semantic or contextual condition observed.
patterns.domain: Chemistry, biomedicine, business articles, entertainment reviews, and encyclopedic texts

0_1561.description: 主要激活于句首或标题中的“Supporting”，以及生物医学肾脏语境中词干“glomer”；另有引用补充材料时的“see”和若干分散的词片段，难以归入共同模式。

patterns.name: “Supporting”小节标题
patterns.context: 出现在标题或小节标题开头，后续内容随语料而异；标题式大小写和换行常见
patterns.domain: 网页文章、科研论文、娱乐评论、百科

patterns.name: 肾小球相关医学词
patterns.context: 嵌在肾脏疾病或组织学相关术语中，通常与肾病分类、肾小球染色或疾病介绍同现

patterns.name: 科研文献引用与补充材料标记

patterns.domain: 科研论文及其网页转录

patterns.name: 其他零散词片段激活

patterns.context: 各段中这些词片段处于不同上下文，未见共同的稳定语义或上下文条件
patterns.domain: 分别涉及化学、生物医学、商业文章、娱乐评论和百科文本

en.concept: Section and category headings in documents
en.description: Primarily activates on Supporting and its use in titles and references to supplementary materials; also activates on the RESULTS section heading in papers, as well as supporting-character/award heading usage. Some result paragraphs contain RESULTS, but other result content drives the strong activation, making it difficult to explain.

patterns.name: Supporting title or material label
patterns.context: The word Supporting appears in a title, section heading, or supplementary-material name; capitalization or formatting varies slightly in [2][3][7].
patterns.domain: Academic papers, biographical/film entries, report titles

patterns.name: Results section heading in academic papers
patterns.context: The results section is marked in the paper body by RESULTS and an equals-sign divider, followed by results or a subheading.
patterns.domain: Research papers, including biomedicine and physics

patterns.name: Cross-references to supplementary materials
patterns.context: The body refers to Supporting Information or Supporting Materials, often with a link, section description, or paper-methods description.

patterns.name: Supporting Actress award category
patterns.context: Used as an award-category heading, followed by winners or nominees.

patterns.name: Supporting Characters category heading
patterns.context: Used as a section heading for character introductions, followed by descriptions of supporting characters or a character group.

patterns.name: General word or term activation in paragraphs
patterns.context: Supporting is used as a verb or present participle modifying mobility in a paragraph-style heading phrase, not as a label for supplementary material in a paper.

0_1561.concept: 文档中的章节与类别标题标记
0_1561.description: 主要对 Supporting 及其标题、补充材料用法激活，也对论文 RESULTS 章节标题激活；另有配角/奖项标题用法。部分结果段落虽含 RESULTS，但强激活词是其他结果内容，难以解释。

patterns.name: Supporting 标题或材料标签
patterns.context: 单词 Supporting 出现在标题、分节标题或补充材料名称中；在 [2][3][7] 中大小写或排版略有差异。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、人物/影视条目、报告标题

patterns.name: 学术论文的结果章节标题
patterns.context: 论文正文中以 RESULTS 和等号线标示结果章节，后接结果内容或小标题。
patterns.domain: 科研论文，含生物医学与物理学

patterns.name: 补充材料交叉引用
patterns.context: 正文指向 Supporting Information 或 Supporting Materials，常伴随链接、章节说明或论文方法描述。

patterns.name: Supporting Actress 影视奖项类别
patterns.context: 作为奖项类别标题，后文列出获奖者或候选人。

patterns.name: Supporting Characters 角色类别标题
patterns.context: 作为角色介绍的分节标题，后文描述配角或角色群体。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、影视/动画介绍

patterns.name: 段落中一般词语或术语激活
patterns.context: Supporting 作动词或现在分词修饰 mobility，出现在段落标题式短语中，不是论文补充材料标签。
patterns.domain: 企业报告或说明性文本

en.description: All segments activate strongly at research paper results section headings, especially RESULTS and its underline-style heading marker. Several sporadic activations occur on statistical and biomedical terms, that, and supplementary-material wording, with no unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: RESULTS heading
patterns.context: The results section heading in a paper body, often following methods, statistical analysis, or research background paragraphs.

patterns.name: Supporting-material heading wording
patterns.context: Mentions supplementary materials on model development and simulation; activation falls on “Supporting”.

patterns.name: Biomedical research terms
patterns.context: Occurs in contexts involving hematologic malignancies, viral infections, or related cell research; these terms are near RESULTS headings, but there is no evidence that they form a common trigger condition.

patterns.name: Statistical analysis wording in results sections
patterns.context: Describes statistical software, significance thresholds, or regression analysis, followed by a RESULTS heading.

patterns.name: Specific academic words
patterns.context: Occur separately in statistical comparisons, software attribution, and supplementary-material wording; they lack consistent context.

patterns.name: Demonstrative pronoun that
patterns.context: Repeatedly appears in clauses in clinical descriptions; it occurs in the same segment as RESULTS headings, but no causal relationship has been established.

0_1561.description: 全部段落都在论文结果章节标题处强烈激活，尤其是 RESULTS 及其下划线式标题标记。若干分散激活落在统计、生物医学词语、that 和补充材料措辞上，缺乏统一触发条件。

patterns.name: RESULTS标题
patterns.trigger: «RESULTS»；有时后接「=======」或 Markdown 标题标记
patterns.context: 论文正文中结果章节的标题位置，常在方法、统计分析或研究背景段落之后
patterns.domain: 学术论文（ArXiv 与 PubMed Central）

patterns.name: 支持材料标题措辞
patterns.context: 提及模型开发与模拟的补充材料；激活落在“Supporting”上

patterns.name: 生物医学研究术语
patterns.context: 出现在血液肿瘤、病毒感染或相关细胞研究语境中；这些词与 RESULTS 标题邻近，但未见它们构成共同触发条件

patterns.name: 结果章节中的统计分析措辞
patterns.context: 描述统计软件、显著性阈值或回归分析，随后出现 RESULTS 标题

patterns.name: 特定学术词语
patterns.context: 分别出现于统计比较、软件出处和补充材料措辞中；单独出现，缺乏一致上下文

patterns.name: 指示代词 that
patterns.context: 临床描述中重复出现于从句；与 RESULTS 标题同段，但尚无证据表明存在因果联系

en.description: The most stable shared pattern is the use of “Results” to mark a results section or discuss research findings in academic papers; there are also sporadic activations on mathematical notation, citation fragments, and physics, materials, and machine-learning terms that are difficult to group into one semantic category.

patterns.name: Results section heading
patterns.context: Used as a standalone section heading, often followed by an equals-sign or hyphen divider; sometimes numbered or paired with Discussion.
patterns.domain: ArXiv papers and their Markdown/R Markdown-style formatting

patterns.name: Results-related wording in body text
patterns.context: The body mentions research results, a results section, or related findings, rather than using the word only as a heading.
patterns.domain: Academic paper body text, including physics and astronomy

patterns.name: mathbb in mathematical notation
patterns.context: Represents a number-set symbol in a LaTeX mathematical expression.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments rin, fer
patterns.context: A LaTeX citation key for the name Pietrini is marked in fragments; activation falls on word-internal fragments, with no obvious semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Physics term orbital contributions
patterns.context: Describes orbital contributions being quenched and related to Zeeman splitting.

patterns.name: Physics term molecular dynamics
patterns.context: Describes classical molecular dynamics simulations used with the BKS potential and CPMD code.

patterns.name: Physics term CP abbreviation
patterns.context: Used as a simulation/computation label alongside BKS.

patterns.name: Experimental physics vocabulary
patterns.context: The wavelength is tuned to measure energy dependence in a sample.

patterns.name: Experimental physics vocabulary
patterns.context: Describes energy-dependence measurements and a superconducting-magnet experimental setup.

patterns.name: Material interface and protection description
patterns.context: Explains the protective effect of an HMDS monolayer on graphene and surrounding water molecules, then shifts to environmental conditions.

patterns.name: Data-splitting terminology
patterns.context: Introduces the lengths of speech-data segments, validation-set allocation, and separation of training and validation sets.

patterns.name: Particle physics terminology
patterns.context: Describes thresholds and particles for proton/antiproton and electron identification.

patterns.name: Wording in conclusions
patterns.context: Discusses testing the principle of mediation and previews the section location and paper conclusion.

0_1561.description: 最稳定的共同模式是学术论文中以“Results”标示结果章节或谈论研究结果；此外还有数学符号、引文片段及若干物理、材料和机器学习术语的零散激活，难以归入同一语义类别。

patterns.name: 结果章节标题

patterns.name: 结果相关正文措辞

patterns.name: 数学记号中的 mathbb

patterns.name: 词内片段 rin、fer

patterns.name: 物理术语 orbital contributions

patterns.name: 物理术语 molecular dynamics

patterns.name: 物理术语 CP 缩写

patterns.name: 物理实验词汇
patterns.context: 波长被调谐以测量样品中的能量依赖

patterns.name: 物理实验词汇
patterns.context: 描述能量依赖测量及超导磁体实验装置

patterns.name: 材料界面与防护描述
patterns.context: 说明 HMDS 单分子层对石墨烯及其周围水分子的保护作用，随后转入环境条件描述

patterns.name: 数据切分术语
patterns.context: 介绍语音数据片段的长度、验证集分配及训练集与验证集隔离
patterns.domain: 语音识别/机器学习论文

patterns.name: 粒子物理术语
patterns.context: 说明质子/反质子与电子鉴别的阈值及粒子

patterns.name: 结论论述用语
patterns.context: 讨论中介性原理的检验，并预告章节位置及论文结论

en.description: Activation is concentrated on “Results” headings marking results sections in papers and their heading dividers; it also occurs in “Results and Discussion” headings and, more weakly, on results in body text or section cross-references. The specific trigger differences are not fully explained.

patterns.name: Research paper results section heading
patterns.context: Used as a standalone section heading or anchored section heading in ArXiv papers, usually after a line break; capitalization and heading format may vary.

patterns.name: Extended results section heading
patterns.context: The results section heading is extended to “Results and Discussion”; capitalization and activation strength of Discussion vary.

patterns.name: Use of results in body text

0_1561.concept: 学术论文结果章节标记
0_1561.description: 激活主要集中在论文中表示结果章节的“Results”标题及其标题分隔符；也见于“Results and Discussion”标题，并较弱地涉及正文中的results或章节交叉引用。具体触发差异未完全解释。

en.description: All segments contain Results headings in paper structure; a few also contain results in body text or cross-references, and heading dividers also activate.

patterns.name: Results section heading
patterns.context: Appears as a section heading or heading text in the paper body, often accompanied by a Markdown heading divider or section reference.

patterns.name: Heading and structural-marker co-activation
patterns.context: Markdown/formatting divider lines near Results headings also activate.

0_1561.concept: 学术论文的 Results 标题

patterns.name: 章节标题 Results

patterns.name: 结果一词的正文用法
