patterns.name: 标题及结构标记伴随模式
patterns.context: Results 标题附近的 Markdown/排版分隔线也有激活

en.description: All segments contain a Results section heading or a marker related to the results section; other activations are spread across disciplinary terms, body-text vocabulary, and formatting markers, and are difficult to group into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Results section heading
patterns.context: Results section heading in the paper body, commonly in Markdown/text-extraction format; sometimes the heading is “Results and Discussion”, or Results occurs in a section cross-reference.

patterns.name: Results-related phrasing
patterns.context: The paragraph reports, introduces, or cross-references research results; apart from headings, activation words are scattered across results paragraphs or citations, with no unified lexical pattern observed.

patterns.name: Sporadic domain-vocabulary activations
patterns.context: Each word activates only near specific research content, terminology, literature markers, or table markers; they show no clear shared local semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Various fields, including mathematics, physics, materials science, speech, astronomy, and document markers

0_1561.concept: 论文 Results 章节标记
0_1561.description: 所有片段都含 Results 章节标题或结果章节相关标记；其余激活分散在不同学科术语、正文词汇及排版标记中，难以归为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: 章节标题 Results
patterns.context: 论文正文中 Results 章节标题，常见 Markdown/文本抽取格式；有时标题为“Results and Discussion”，或 Results 出现在章节交叉引用中。

patterns.name: 结果相关表述
patterns.context: 段落正在报告、引出或交叉引用研究结果；除标题外的激活词分散在结果段落或引用中，未见统一的词法模式。

patterns.name: 零散领域词汇激活
patterns.context: 各词只在特定研究内容、术语、文献标记或表格标记附近激活；彼此未呈现明显共同的局部语义条件。
patterns.domain: 数学、物理、材料、语音、天文学及文档标记等不同领域

en.description: Most sensitive to Results headings in academic papers; also responds to results/Results in body text, cross-references to results sections, and Markdown dividers near headings or tables.

patterns.name: Results section heading
patterns.context: Used as a standalone section heading or part of a heading, usually near divider lines, section numbers, or heading-format markers; capitalized with an initial uppercase letter.

patterns.name: Ordinary results-related word
patterns.context: Appears in a body-text phrase or section name rather than as a standalone heading; capitalization and surrounding words vary.

patterns.name: Heading-format divider
patterns.context: Markdown heading underlines or table divider lines appear alongside Results headings.

patterns.name: Results section cross-reference
patterns.context: The target of a bracketed section reference, embedded in a citation marker such as “\[SEC:Results\]”.

0_1561.concept: 学术论文结果章节标记
0_1561.description: 对学术论文中的 Results 标题最敏感；也响应正文里 results/Results 一词、结果章节交叉引用，以及标题或表格附近的 Markdown 分隔符。

patterns.name: 章节标题 Results
patterns.context: 作为独立章节标题或标题文本的一部分，通常出现在分隔线、章节编号或标题格式标记附近；大小写为首字母大写
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文的 Markdown/LaTeX 转换文本

patterns.name: 结果相关普通词语
patterns.context: 出现在正文短语或章节名中，而非独立标题；大小写和周围词语不固定

patterns.name: 标题格式分隔符
patterns.context: 与 Results 标题附近的 Markdown 标题下划线或表格分隔线同时出现

patterns.name: 结果章节交叉引用
patterns.context: 作为方括号内章节引用的目标，嵌在类似“\[SEC:Results\]”的引用标记中
patterns.domain: 学术论文内部交叉引用

en.description: All segments strongly activate on the capacity unit litre, spanning mathematical conversions, concentrations or yields per litre, and engine displacement. The mathematics segments also show related subpatterns such as unit conversions, quantity questions, time units, and fractional expressions.

patterns.name: litre as a volume unit
patterns.context: The capacity unit litre appears before or after phrases such as “a litre in millilitres” in conversion problems or “per litre” in scientific or patent texts; activation is concentrated on the unit word itself
patterns.domain: Math problems, scientific papers, patent texts, everyday emails

patterns.name: Unit conversion instructions
patterns.context: Math questions ask to convert a quantity or fractional amount from one unit to another; often co-occurs with litre and millilitres

patterns.name: Quantity questions and time units
patterns.context: Math problems ask how many smaller units are contained in a time span or unit; relations involving decade, millennium, centuries, and weeks also appear

patterns.name: Fractions or ratios modifying quantities
patterns.context: A fraction expresses part of a quantity or a multiple, especially fractions of a litre converted to millilitres; fractional millennium conversions also occur

patterns.name: Concentration units in scientific media
patterns.context: Describes the inorganic nutrient content of basal medium in milligrams per litre; unlike math conversion problems, this is a concentration expression in scientific text

patterns.name: Yield per litre in patent text
patterns.context: Describes industrial FVIII yield in plasma, measured in international units per litre; embedded in patent text about hemophilia

patterns.name: litre in engine displacement
patterns.context: An automotive email uses litre for engine displacement, followed by discussion of operating condition; no conversion or concentration context

0_1668.description: 所有段都在 litre 这一容量单位处强烈激活，覆盖数学换算、每升浓度或产量及发动机排量。数学段还呈现单位换算、数量询问、时间单位和分数表达等相关子模式。

patterns.name: 升量单位中的 litre
patterns.trigger: «litre»10，常见框架为“of a litre in millilitres”或“per litre”
patterns.context: 出现容量单位 litre，前后可为换算题中的“a litre in millilitres”，也可为科学或专利文本中的“per litre”；激活集中在单位词本身
patterns.domain: 数学题、科学论文、专利文本、日常邮件

patterns.name: 单位换算指令
patterns.trigger: «Convert»3、“« in»”1、“« to»”3及“« millilitres»”等单位表达
patterns.context: 数学问答中要求将数值或分数对应的量从一种单位换算为另一种单位；常与 litre、millilitres 同现
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的单位换算题

patterns.name: 量化询问与时间单位
patterns.context: 数学题询问一个时间跨度或单位中包含多少较小单位；也出现 decade、millennium、centuries、weeks 等关系
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的时间单位应用题

patterns.name: 分数或比例修饰数量
patterns.context: 分数表达数量的一部分或倍数，尤以分数 litre 换算为 millilitres 为主；另有 millennium 的分数换算
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的分数应用题

patterns.name: 科学介质中的浓度单位
patterns.context: 描述基础培养基中的无机营养物含量，以每升毫克表示；与数学换算题不同，是科学文本中的浓度表述
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

patterns.name: 专利文本中的每升产量
patterns.context: 描述血浆中 FVIII 的工业产量，单位为每升国际单位；嵌在血友病背景专利文字中

patterns.name: 发动机排量中的 litre
patterns.context: 汽车邮件中以 litre 表示发动机排量，随后谈到运行状况；没有换算或浓度语境

en.description: Strongly responds to litre and expressions involving the unit, especially fraction-to-millilitre conversions with litre as the subject in math problems; also activates in scientific concentration, plasma yield, and automotive displacement texts containing litre. Math problems also involve general conversion questions, fractions, and other units.

patterns.name: litre in capacity-unit conversions
patterns.context: Questions ask how many millilitres are equivalent to a fraction or multiple of a litre, or how other units convert to litres; litre is also used in numerical quantities or as a measurement unit
patterns.domain: Math unit conversions (DM Mathematics); capacity units in scientific tables, patent technical texts, and automotive emails

patterns.name: Unit-conversion instructions and question formats
patterns.context: Consecutive conversion problems combine quantities and measurement units; units besides litre include length, time, and mass

patterns.name: Problems multiplying fractions by litre
patterns.context: A fraction, fraction word, or quantity is given, followed by a question asking for the corresponding number of millilitres; a numerical answer usually follows directly

patterns.name: Conversions of units other than litre and time units
patterns.context: Other mass, time, or length units and their conversions appear in the same set of math exercises; some problems do not involve litre

patterns.name: Per-litre content in scientific media
patterns.context: Describes the inorganic nutrient content of basal medium, with litre linked to mass concentration per litre
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, culture-medium methods or composition descriptions

patterns.name: Plasma yield per litre in technical texts
patterns.context: Industrial FVIII yield is measured per litre of plasma and in IU; not a question-and-answer conversion problem
patterns.domain: Patent background, medical or biotechnology descriptions

patterns.name: Automotive displacement
patterns.context: A numerical engine displacement precedes litre in an everyday email asking about precautions for a particular vehicle model

0_1668.description: 强烈响应 litre 及其单位表达，尤其是数学题中以 litre 为对象的分数—毫升换算；也激活于含 litre 的科学浓度、血浆产率和汽车排量文本。数学题还伴随一般换算问句、分数及其他单位。

patterns.name: 容量单位换算中的 litre
patterns.trigger: “a litre”“of a litre”“per litre”，尤其是 «litre»10；多次伴随“in”
patterns.context: 问题询问某个分数或倍数的 litre 等于多少 millilitres，或其他单位如何换算为 litres；另有把 litre 用于组成数值或测量单位的情况
patterns.domain: 数学单位换算（DM Mathematics）；科学表格、专利技术文本和汽车邮件中的容量单位

patterns.name: 单位换算指令及问句格式
patterns.trigger: “«Convert»”“«How» many”“«in»”，以及“to”“are there”等换算问句成分
patterns.context: 与数值和测量单位构成连续的单位转换题；除 litre 外，还出现长度、时间、质量等单位

patterns.name: 分数乘以 litre 的题型
patterns.trigger: “one fifth of a micro«gram» in «nan»ograms”“«3»/«2» of a «litre»”“«seven» «quarters» of a «litre»”“«five» «eight»hs of a «litre»”及相似短语
patterns.context: 先给出分数、分数词或数量，再询问对应的 litre 数量换算成 millilitres；题后通常直接给出数值答案
patterns.domain: 分数与体积单位换算练习

patterns.name: 非 litre 的单位换算与时间单位
patterns.context: 同一批数学练习中出现的其他质量、时间或长度单位及其换算；部分题目不涉及 litre

patterns.name: 科学介质中每升含量
patterns.context: 描述 basal medium 的无机营养物含量，litre 与每升质量浓度相连
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、培养基方法或成分说明

patterns.name: 技术文本中的 plasma 每升产率
patterns.context: FVIII 的工业产率按每升血浆及 IU 计量；不属于问答式换算题
patterns.domain: 专利背景、医学或生物技术说明

patterns.name: 汽车排量
patterns.context: litre 前为发动机排量数值，处在询问特定车型注意事项的日常邮件中

en.description: The most stable trigger is litre, especially in fractional capacity conversions and “in millilitres” questions; it also covers adjacent conversion problems involving time and length units. In a few non-question contexts, litre appears in per-litre concentrations, plasma yields, and engine-displacement expressions.

patterns.name: litre units and their conversion
patterns.context: In capacity-conversion problems, litre often pairs with a fraction or quantity and must be converted to millilitres; it also appears in scientific corpora as a unit for concentration per litre.
patterns.domain: Math word problems, scientific papers, patent background

patterns.name: Conversion problem instructions
patterns.context: Appears in a sequence of unit-conversion problems asking how many of one unit are in another, or requiring conversion of a measured quantity to another unit.

patterns.name: Fractions multiplied by capacity
patterns.context: A fraction or fraction word modifies litre, and the problem asks for the equivalent number of millilitres; activation does not depend on a particular fraction size.

patterns.name: Conversions of other time units
patterns.context: Math problems ask how many months, hours, years, or centuries correspond to a fractional or decimal amount of a time unit; these appear alongside litre problems.

patterns.name: Length and microscopic-scale unit conversions
patterns.context: A Convert instruction is followed by a measured quantity, which must be converted to another unit; some values are split into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Per-litre expressions in scientific concentrations
patterns.context: Ingredient or nutrient content is expressed as milligrams per litre of culture medium; litre occurs in a parenthetical technical concentration description.

patterns.name: Per-litre expressions in plasma yield
patterns.context: Describes the industrial yield of a substance in plasma, measured in international units per litre of plasma.

patterns.name: Automotive engine displacement
patterns.context: In casual automotive discussion, litre indicates engine displacement; the number and unit form a natural-language specification, not a conversion problem.

0_1668.description: 最稳定的触发是 litre，尤其在分数容量换算及“in millilitres”题式中；也覆盖时间、长度等相邻单位换算题。少数非题目语境中，litre 出现在每升浓度、血浆产率和发动机排量表达里。

patterns.name: litre 单位及其换算
patterns.trigger: «litre»10；« in»1 millilitres；« in»1 litres；« per»4« litre»10
patterns.context: 在容量换算题中，litre 常与分数或数量搭配，要求换算成 millilitres；也出现在科学语料中作为每升浓度单位。
patterns.domain: 数学应用题、科学论文、专利背景

patterns.name: 换算题指令
patterns.context: 出现在连续生成的单位换算题中，询问某单位中有多少另一单位，或要求将一个带数值的量转换为另一单位。

patterns.name: 分数乘以容量
patterns.trigger: «quarters»2 of a« litre»10；« fifth»s»1 of a« litre»10；« halves»；« eight»2«hs of a« litre»10
patterns.context: 分数或分数词修饰 litre，问题要求给出等值毫升数；触发并不依赖特定分数大小。

patterns.name: 其他时间单位换算
patterns.context: 数学题中询问分数或小数个时间单位对应的月份、小时、年或世纪数；与 litre 题并列出现。

patterns.name: 长度与微小尺度单位换算
patterns.trigger: «cm« to»4« kilometers»；«nm« to»4 centimeters»；«ml« to»4 litres»
patterns.context: Convert 指令后接带数值的单位量，要求换算为另一计量单位；部分数值被切分为多个 token。

patterns.name: 科学浓度中的每升表达
patterns.context: 成分或营养物质的含量以每升培养基的毫克数表示；litre 处于括号内的技术性浓度描述中。

patterns.name: 血浆产率中的每升表达
patterns.trigger: «yield»1 of FV«III»2« from»1 plasma ... «per»4« litre»10 of plasma
patterns.context: 描述血浆中某物质的工业产率，单位为每升血浆的国际单位数。

patterns.name: 汽车发动机排量
patterns.context: 汽车闲聊中以 litre 表示发动机排量，数字与单位构成自然语言中的规格描述，不是换算题。

en.description: The most stable pattern is “litre” and the measurement/conversion phrases around it; math problems also involve time units and general conversion instructions. Other uses of litre occur in culture-medium concentrations, plasma yield, and automotive engine displacement.

patterns.name: Question-and-answer conversions of the volume unit litre
patterns.context: In math exercises asking how to convert fractions, decimal quantities, or other volume units to millilitres/litres, activation concentrates on “litre” and related conversion wording; also includes “in” and “to” in millilitre conversion problems.

patterns.name: Time-unit conversions
patterns.context: In math questions about fractions or quantities of time units, activation occurs on unit names and question wording such as “How many … are there in”; these often appear in sequences of conversion problems.

patterns.name: General unit-conversion instructions
patterns.context: In problems requiring a numerical quantity in one unit to be converted to another, activation appears near the instruction or unit connector; problems cover length, mass, time, or volume.

patterns.name: Scientific table references and nutrient descriptions
patterns.context: Describes inorganic macronutrients and their concentrations in culture medium, with a table reference; “in” and “litre” appear in a measurement phrase.

patterns.name: Plasma FVIII yield measurement
patterns.context: Describes plasma FVIII yield, measured in international units per litre of plasma; activation occurs on “litre.”
patterns.domain: USPTO Backgrounds, medical/industrial descriptions in patent background

patterns.name: Automotive engine displacement
patterns.context: The “litre” following a displacement value activates when an email mentions a specific vehicle model, engine, and driving conditions.

0_1668.description: 最稳定的模式是“litre”及其所在的单位计量/换算短语；数学题中还涉及时间单位和一般换算指令。另有培养基浓度、血浆产量和汽车发动机排量等非数学语境中的 litre 用法。

patterns.name: 体积单位 litre 的换算问答
patterns.context: 在以问句要求把分数、带小数的数量或其他体积单位换算为毫升/升的数学练习中，神经元集中激活于“litre”及相关换算措辞；也包括毫升换算题中的“in”“to”。

patterns.name: 时间单位换算
patterns.context: 数学问句询问分数或数量对应的时间单位时，对单位名称及“How many … are there in”一类问句措辞激活；常与换算题串在一起。

patterns.name: 一般单位换算指令
patterns.context: 在要求将某单位数值转换为另一单位的题目中，激活出现在指令或单位连接词附近；题目涉及长度、质量、时间或体积。

patterns.name: 科学表格引用与营养成分描述
patterns.context: 描述培养基的无机常量营养物质及其浓度，伴有表格引用；“in”与“litre”出现在计量短语中。

patterns.name: 血浆 FVIII 浓度计量
patterns.context: 说明 FVIII 血浆产量，并以每升血浆的国际单位表示；“litre”处激活。
patterns.domain: USPTO Backgrounds，专利背景中的医学/工业说明

patterns.name: 汽车发动机排量
patterns.context: 邮件提到具体车型、发动机及驾驶情况时，排量数值后的“litre”激活。

en.description: The strongest signal centers on litre: in math problems it appears especially in conversion questions between litres and millilitres, and also in scientific content per litre, yield per litre, and automotive engine displacement; conversion instructions and question openings show weaker activation.

patterns.name: litre in capacity-unit conversions
patterns.context: Arithmetic questions ask how many millilitres correspond to a litre or a fraction or multiple of a litre; activation primarily occurs on the unit name in the question.

patterns.name: General conversion instructions
patterns.context: Instructions or question openings in unit-conversion problems, followed by a quantity, unit, or “How many …” structure; these occur in the same set as litre problems, but not in every segment.

patterns.name: Nutrient content per litre
patterns.context: Nutrient content is expressed as the number of milligrams per litre of basal medium, in a parenthetical scientific description.

patterns.name: Plasma yield per litre
patterns.context: Industrial FVIII plasma yield is expressed as international units per litre of plasma; the trigger is litre in the unit expression.
patterns.domain: USPTO Backgrounds, medical/industrial descriptions in patent background

patterns.name: Engine displacement unit
patterns.context: Engine displacement is given in litres in casual automotive discussion; this is neither a conversion problem nor a “per litre” usage.

0_1668.description: 最强信号集中在 litre：在数学题中尤其出现在升与毫升的换算问句，也出现在科学的每升含量、每升产量及汽车发动机排量中；另有换算指令和疑问开头的较弱激活。

patterns.name: 容量单位换算中的 litre
patterns.context: 关于升及其分数、倍数对应多少毫升的算术问句；主要在问句中的单位名处激活。

patterns.name: 通用换算指令
patterns.context: 单位换算题的指令或疑问开头，后接数量、单位或“How many …”结构；与 litre 题群同属练习文本，但并非每段均出现。

patterns.name: 每升营养成分表述
patterns.context: 营养成分以每升基础培养基所含毫克数表示，位于括号中的科学说明文字。

patterns.name: 血浆每升产量
patterns.context: FVIII 血浆工业产量以每升血浆的国际单位数表示；触发点是单位表达中的 litre。
patterns.domain: USPTO Backgrounds，专利背景中的医学/工业说明

patterns.name: 发动机排量单位
patterns.context: 汽车闲聊中以升标注发动机排量；不是换算题，也不是“每升”用法。

en.description: All segments strongly activate on the stem «travers» in split words, including traversing, traversed, and traversable, in contexts involving passage along paths, through spatial regions, or across brain regions; domains and styles vary.

patterns.name: Stem in traversing
patterns.context: The trigger word is split, with «travers» as the high-activation part followed by -ing; appears in contexts describing movement along or through a path, region, or distance.
patterns.domain: Various styles, including academic papers, political reporting, legal texts, and narrative

patterns.name: Stem in traversed
patterns.context: The trigger word is split, with «travers» as the high-activation part followed by -ed; describes a path or region previously crossed by something or someone.
patterns.domain: Directory text, geographic or travel narratives

patterns.name: Stem in traversable
patterns.context: The trigger word is split, with «travers» as the high-activation part followed by -able; indicates that an area can be crossed or passed through.

patterns.name: Medical use of traversed
patterns.context: An electrode passes through a brain region during surgery or measurement; consistent with general usage of crossing, but specifically refers to intracranial probing.

0_1668.description: 各段均强烈激活于拆分词中的词干 «travers»，涵盖 traversing、traversed、traversable，语境涉及路径、空间区域或脑区的穿越；领域和文体多样。

patterns.name: traversing 的词干
patterns.context: 触发词拆分后以 «travers» 为高激活部分，后接 -ing；出现在描述沿路径、区域或距离移动/穿过的语境。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、政治报道、法律文本、叙事等多种文体

patterns.name: traversed 的词干
patterns.context: 触发词拆分后以 «travers» 为高激活部分，后接 -ed；描述某物或某人曾穿越、经过的路径或区域。
patterns.domain: 目录文字、地理或旅行叙述

patterns.name: traversable 的词干
patterns.context: 触发词拆分后以 «travers» 为高激活部分，后接 -able；说明某区域可以通过或穿越。

patterns.name: traversed 的医学用法
patterns.context: 电极在手术或测量过程中穿过脑区；与一般的穿越用法一致，但语境专指脑内探测。

en.description: Nearly all segments activate on English word forms containing travers-, covering movement across or through something and traversable; there is also one French fixed phrase, à travers. The common feature is the travers form, not a particular domain or object being crossed.

patterns.name: Verb forms of travers-
patterns.context: The core trigger is the English root travers-, appearing in present participles, third-person singular forms, past-tense forms, and derived adjectives; the object may be a path, spatial region, cosmic distance, data, or a microelectrode.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English corpora, including machine learning, astrophysics, condensed matter physics, computer science, legal geography, travel narratives, ethnography, and medicine

patterns.name: French preposition à travers
patterns.context: The French fixed prepositional phrase à travers means “through/by way of”; it appears in political commentary, followed by person­ne du juge.

0_1668.description: 几乎所有片段都在 travers- 英文词形处激活，涵盖穿行、穿越、 traversable 等用法；另有一次法语固定短语 à travers。共同线索是 travers 词形，而非特定领域或穿越对象。

patterns.name: 动词形式 travers-
patterns.context: 核心触发是英文词根 travers-，出现在动词现在分词、第三人称单数、过去式及派生形容词中；具体对象可为路径、空间区域、宇宙距离、数据或微电极。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英文语料，包括机器学习、天体物理、凝聚态物理、计算机、法律地理、旅行叙事、民族志与医学

patterns.name: 法语介词 à travers
patterns.context: 法语固定介词短语 à travers，表示“通过/经由”；出现在政治评论中，后接 person­ne du juge。

en.description: Every segment contains a highlighted portion of the intellig- stem: intelligently, intelligible, intelligibly, or intelligentsia. The contexts concern legal decisions, prudent action, comprehensibility, and the term for an intellectual class.

patterns.name: intelligently and its derivatives
patterns.context: The core trigger is the word stem beginning with intellig; it may occur in different word forms.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain texts, including academic, legal, technical discussions, literature, and web articles

patterns.name: Making rational, informed legal decisions
patterns.context: In legal contexts, co-occurs with actions such as handling disputes, waiving rights, or making litigation choices.

patterns.name: Handling problems or acting wisely
patterns.context: Emphasizes acting prudently and effectively when choosing a method, adjusting parameters, or implementing reforms.

patterns.name: Understandable or communicable expression or content
patterns.context: Describes content that is easy to understand or can be communicated through comprehension; the form is not limited to intelligently.
patterns.domain: Literary paraphrase, religious philosophy, academic discussion

patterns.name: intelligentsia referring to the intellectual class
patterns.context: Used as a noun for the intellectual community or group of intellectuals; differs from the adverb and adjective uses in other segments.

0_1668.description: 所有段落都含 intellig- 词干的高亮部分：intelligently、intelligible、intelligibly 或 intelligentsia。具体语境分属法律决策、审慎行动、可理解性及知识阶层称谓。

patterns.name: intelligently 及其派生形式
patterns.context: 核心触发点是单词中以 intellig 开头的词干；可出现在不同词形中。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本，包括学术、法律、技术讨论、文学与网络文章

patterns.name: 理性、知情地作出法律决定
patterns.trigger: “intelligently address”“intelligently waived”“acted fairly, intelligently and reasonably”“intelligently elects”
patterns.context: 法律语境中与处理争议、放弃权利或作出诉讼选择等行为搭配。

patterns.name: 明智地处理问题或采取行动
patterns.context: 强调选择方法、调整参数或实施改革时要审慎、有效。
patterns.domain: 技术论文、公共政策讨论

patterns.name: 可理解、可交流的表达或内容
patterns.context: 描述内容易于理解，或能够借助理解进行交流；词形不限于 intelligently。
patterns.domain: 文学译述、宗教哲学、学术讨论

patterns.name: intelligentsia 指称知识阶层
patterns.context: 作为名词，指知识界或知识分子群体；与其他段落的副词及形容词用法不同。
patterns.domain: 奇幻叙事或虚构世界背景介绍

en.description: All segments activate on the spelling fragment “Treasure”; most refer to the office title “treasurer,” while a few use the common noun for treasure.

patterns.name: Treasurer role or title
patterns.context: Appears near a person’s name or an office description, referring to a state treasurer, an organization’s financial officer, or similar roles; modifiers or following names vary by passage.
patterns.domain: Legal decisions, biographical and organizational descriptions, emails

patterns.name: Common noun treasure
patterns.context: Used as a noun in a book title or fixed expression, referring to treasure; it need not relate to an office or person’s name.
patterns.domain: Novel titles, quoted phrases in academic texts

0_1668.description: 所有段落都激活于拼写片段“Treasure”；多数是“treasurer”官职称谓，少数是指宝藏的普通名词。

patterns.name: Treasurer 职务或头衔
patterns.context: 出现在人名或官职介绍附近，指州财政官、组织财务职务等；前置修饰语或后续姓名因文段而异。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、百科人物与组织介绍、邮件

patterns.name: treasure 普通名词
patterns.context: 作为名词出现在书名或固定表达中，指宝藏；不要求与官职或人名相关。
patterns.domain: 小说标题、学术文本中的引述短语

en.description: The first five segments activate on an internal substring in words containing gan; the last five activate on the English word paying, covering payment and “paying attention” uses. The two groups differ in both trigger form and meaning.

patterns.name: “gan” substring
patterns.context: A word or phrase containing the letter sequence gan; segment 1 is a Portuguese verb form, segments 2 and 3 are Latvian, and segments 4 and 5 are internal substrings in English-text words
patterns.domain: European Parliament texts, food essays, encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: The word “paying”
patterns.context: English uses of paying; meanings include paying for a subscription, paying an electricity bill, or providing a return, as well as the fixed phrase “paying attention”

0_1668.description: 前五段在含 gan 的词内子串处激活；后五段在英语 paying 一词处激活，涵盖付费、支付及“paying attention”等用法。两组触发形式与语义均不相同。

patterns.name: “gan”子串
patterns.context: 含有字母串 gan 的词或词组；第1段是葡萄牙语动词词形，第2、3段是拉脱维亚语，第4、5段是英语文本中的词内子串
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本、食品随笔、百科条目

patterns.name: “paying”一词
patterns.context: 英语中出现 paying；语义包括付费订阅、支付电费或回报，另有固定搭配“paying attention”
patterns.domain: 论文、商务邮件、法律文本

en.description: All fragments activate on paying: contexts include subscribers paying, businesses paying energy costs, paying interest or wages, covering defense fees or construction costs, and stopping employee compensation; occurs in academic papers, business emails, and legal documents.

patterns.name: Lexical activation of paying
patterns.context: The word form paying appears in different grammatical structures; the surrounding semantics typically involve payment or stopping payment.
patterns.domain: Physics papers, business emails, legal texts

0_1668.description: 所有片段均激活 paying：涵盖订阅者付费、企业支付能源费用、支付利息或工资、承担辩护费或建设成本，以及停止支付员工薪酬；出现于学术论文、商业邮件与法律文书。

patterns.name: paying 的词汇激活
patterns.context: 词形 paying 出现在不同语法结构中；周围语义通常涉及支付或停止支付。
patterns.domain: 物理学论文、商业邮件、法律文本

en.concept: Boundaries and markers in structured text
en.description: Activations are scattered across paper formulas and tables, source-code syntax and identifiers, Markdown regexes, and license disclaimers; common triggers include structural symbols such as parentheses, code subword fragments, and fixed uppercase wording. No single semantic pattern explains all samples.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and parenthesis boundaries
patterns.context: In formulas, mathematical expressions, or LaTeX notation, especially near parentheses, intervals, and set-relation symbols; activation also covers several adjacent mathematical tokens.

patterns.name: LaTeX math font commands
patterns.context: Command arguments, braces, and typesetting environments in LaTeX source.

patterns.name: Astronomy fields in tables
patterns.context: Table columns list fields such as celestial wavelength bands or mass, adjacent to units and citations.

patterns.name: Programming syntax punctuation and parentheses
patterns.context: In code, at function bodies, function calls, array access, or regex syntax; triggers are not limited to one use of parentheses.

patterns.name: Case and word boundaries in code identifiers
patterns.context: Components of camelCase identifiers, or code vocabulary such as function, type, and member names.

patterns.name: Numbers and underscores in code
patterns.context: Variable or macro names containing numbers or underscores, or near number-related variables and calls.

patterns.name: Markdown heading syntax
patterns.context: Regex descriptions of the beginning of Markdown heading lines, hash marks, and heading text.

patterns.name: License disclaimer wording
patterns.context: Fixed uppercase disclaimer phrases emphasizing the absence of warranties and warranties of fitness.

patterns.name: Connector- and readiness-related code
patterns.context: Code snippets for checking connection status, determining whether a target object is ready, and registering callbacks.

patterns.name: General English function words
patterns.context: Ordinary English connectives and words in mathematics paper prose or license sentences; triggers are sporadic.

0_1668.concept: 结构化文本中的边界与标记
0_1668.description: 激活分散于论文公式和表格、源码语法与标识符、Markdown 正则及许可证免责声明；常见触发包括括号等结构符号、代码词片段和大写固定措辞，未见能统一解释全部样本的单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 数学符号与括号边界
patterns.context: 公式、数学表达式或 LaTeX 记号中，尤其是括号、区间和集合关系符号附近；激活也覆盖若干相邻数学 token。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学字体命令
patterns.context: LaTeX 源码中的命令参数、花括号及排版环境。

patterns.name: 表格中的天文学字段
patterns.context: 表格列列出天体波段或质量等字段，紧邻单位与引用信息。

patterns.name: 编程语法标点与括号
patterns.context: 代码中函数体、函数调用、数组访问或正则表达式语法位置；触发并不限定于某一种括号用途。

patterns.name: 代码标识符的大小写与词边界
patterns.context: 驼峰式标识符的组成部分，或函数、类型、成员名等代码词汇。

patterns.name: 代码中的数字与下划线
patterns.context: 变量名或宏名中含数字、下划线，或数字相关变量与调用附近。

patterns.name: Markdown 标题语法
patterns.context: 正则表达式描述 Markdown 标题行的开头、井号与标题文本。

patterns.name: 许可证免责声明措辞
patterns.context: 大写免责声明固定短语中，强调不提供保证及适用性保证。
patterns.domain: 许可证文本与源文件注释

patterns.name: 连接器与就绪状态相关代码
patterns.context: 连接状态检查、目标对象就绪判断及回调注册的代码片段。

patterns.name: 通用英语功能词
patterns.context: 数学论文正文或许可证句子中的普通英语连接词与词语；触发较零散。

en.description: Activations are cross-domain and scattered, often occurring at parentheses, intervals, and code syntax boundaries; a few other terms include Brownian motion, Spectrum, MR, and license disclaimers. No single semantic pattern explains them.

patterns.name: Opening parentheses and square brackets in mathematical text
patterns.context: After a left square bracket or left parenthesis in LaTeX mathematical expressions or code; nearby content typically includes a range, function argument, interval, or table entry, while the right side is unmarked or activates separately.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics and physics texts, and Github code

patterns.name: Brownian motion collocation
patterns.context: In the phrase “Brownian motion,” activation falls on motion; the context concerns processes, their path spaces, and probability measures.

patterns.name: Spectrum as a table heading
patterns.context: The word “Spectrum” is split into two subword tokens and used as a column heading in an astrophysics data table.

patterns.name: Substring in the MR notation
patterns.context: Occurs in the function-space notation \textit{MR}, surrounded by function spaces and regularity conditions.

patterns.name: Opening curly brace in code syntax
patterns.context: An opening curly brace for a function body or object/block in code, usually followed by statements or callback content.

patterns.name: Opening group parenthesis in code regex
patterns.context: Serves as the start of a capture group in a regex or pattern match; a character class or pattern follows immediately.

patterns.name: License disclaimer wording
patterns.context: Uppercase disclaimer wording followed by fixed legal expressions such as “MERCHANTABILITY” and “FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE”.

patterns.name: C preprocessor directives and macro paths
patterns.context: C preprocessor directives and macro names after a license paragraph; they occur in the same segment as the preceding disclaimer but are semantically distinct.

patterns.name: Numbers near interval endpoints
patterns.context: Boundaries, ranges, or table fields in square brackets or interval notation; activation concentrates near brackets/boundaries, while the specific mathematical meaning varies by context.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics and physics texts, Github code

0_1668.description: 激活跨领域且分散，常落在括号、区间及代码语法边界；另有 Brownian motion、Spectrum、MR、许可证免责声明等少数词项，无法由单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 数学文本中的开括号与方括号
patterns.context: 出现在 LaTeX 数学表达式或代码中的左方括号/左圆括号后；附近通常是范围、函数参数、区间或表格条目，右侧内容未标记或另有激活。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学、物理文本及 Github 代码

patterns.name: Brownian motion 搭配词
patterns.context: 短语“Brownian motion”中，激活落在 motion；上下文是过程及其路径空间、概率测度。

patterns.name: 谱表标题词
patterns.context: 单词“Spectrum”被拆成两个子词标记，作为天体物理数据表的列标题。

patterns.name: MR 符号中的子串
patterns.context: 出现在函数空间记号 \textit{MR} 中，周围是函数空间及正则性条件。

patterns.name: 代码语法中的左花括号
patterns.context: 代码中函数体或对象/块的左花括号，后续通常是语句或回调内容。

patterns.name: 代码正则式中的分组左括号
patterns.context: 正则表达式或模式匹配中作为捕获组起始符；周围紧接字符类或模式。

patterns.name: 许可证免责声明用语
patterns.context: 大写免责声明措辞，后接“MERCHANTABILITY”及“FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE”等法律固定表达。

patterns.name: C 预处理指令与宏路径
patterns.context: 许可证段落之后的 C 预处理指令和宏名；与前面的免责声明同段，但语义上不同。

patterns.name: 区间端点附近的数字
patterns.context: 方括号或区间表示中的边界、范围或表格字段，激活集中在括号/边界附近；具体数学意义随上下文变化。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学与物理文本、Github 代码

en.description: The most stable trigger is NULL in source code: used for initialization, returns, null-pointer checks, and comments describing failure returns. Newline boundaries and several identifiers also trigger sporadically, without a shared semantic pattern.

patterns.name: NULL pointer or null value
patterns.context: NULL used as an initialization value, return value, or null marker compared with a pointer; the surrounding context is C/C++-style code.
patterns.domain: Github source code: C/C++ and Objective-C code

patterns.name: Newlines and code boundaries
patterns.context: Consecutive newlines occur in function bodies, code blocks, or access-modifier boundaries, often in the same segment as NULL markers.

patterns.name: Other code token patterns
patterns.context: Each triggers only in local code contexts, with no stable shared semantic condition; typically part of an identifier, type, member name, or macro.

patterns.name: NULL semantics in comments
patterns.context: Documentation states that invalid or nonconforming input returns NULL, especially when string or BLOB length validation fails.

patterns.name: Path filename handling
patterns.context: Finds the filename after a slash in a path and handles NULL when none is found.

0_1668.concept: 源码中的 NULL 空值
0_1668.description: 最稳定的触发是源码中的 NULL：用于初始化、返回、空指针判断及注释中的失败返回。另有换行边界和若干零散标识符触发，缺乏共同语义。

patterns.name: NULL 指针或空值
patterns.context: NULL 作为初始化值、返回值或与指针比较的空值标记；周围是 C/C++ 风格代码。
patterns.domain: Github 源码：C/C++ 及 Objective-C 代码

patterns.name: 换行与代码边界
patterns.context: 连续换行出现在函数体、代码块或访问修饰符边界，常与 NULL 标记同段出现。

patterns.name: 其他代码 token 模式
patterns.context: 各自只在局部代码上下文中触发，未见稳定的共同语义条件；通常是标识符、类型、成员名或宏的一部分。
patterns.domain: 多种 Github 源码项目

patterns.name: 注释中的 NULL 语义
patterns.context: 文档说明非法或不合要求的输入会返回 NULL，尤其是字符串或 BLOB 长度校验失败。

patterns.name: 路径文件名处理
patterns.context: 从路径中查找斜杠后的文件名，并在未找到时处理 NULL。

en.description: Primarily responds to NULL pointer operations in C/C++: assigning or clearing, returning, and null checks; it also covers comments describing NULL return behavior. Code newline boundaries may strengthen activation.

patterns.name: NULL assignment and initialization
patterns.context: C/C++ code initializes a pointer or object handle to NULL, or clears it; often within a variable declaration, resource cleanup, or function body

patterns.name: NULL return value
patterns.context: A function returns a null pointer on failure, invalid input, or missing data; often accompanied by validation or early exit

patterns.name: NULL null-check condition
patterns.context: Checks whether a pointer parameter or member is null, usually followed by return or error handling

patterns.name: Newlines and code boundaries near NULL
patterns.context: A newline, blank line, or function/code-block boundary immediately follows a NULL assignment or return; may co-trigger with the NULL pattern

patterns.name: NULL in ordinary text
patterns.context: Documentation comments describe a function returning NULL when input does not meet requirements, rather than executable code

0_1668.description: 主要响应 C/C++ 中的 NULL 指针操作：赋值或清空、作为返回值、判空检查；也覆盖注释中对 NULL 返回行为的说明。代码换行边界可能增强激活。

patterns.name: NULL 赋值与初始化
patterns.context: C/C++ 代码中将指针或对象句柄初始化、清空为 NULL；常处于变量声明、资源释放或函数体内

patterns.name: NULL 返回值
patterns.context: 函数遇到失败、无效输入或缺失数据时返回空指针；常伴随校验或提前退出

patterns.name: NULL 判空条件
patterns.context: 检查指针参数或成员是否为空，通常随后 return 或执行错误处理

patterns.name: NULL 附近的换行与代码边界
patterns.context: NULL 赋值或返回后紧邻换行、空行及函数/代码块边界；可能与 NULL 模式共同触发

patterns.name: 普通文本中的 NULL
patterns.context: 文档注释描述函数在输入不符合要求时返回 NULL，而非实际执行的代码

en.description: All fragments activate in source code or comments containing NULL, with the strongest marker concentrated on NULL; common contexts include null-pointer assignment, returns, comparisons, and failure handling. Other markers are sporadic and show no independent pattern.

patterns.name: NULL constant assignment, return, or comparison
patterns.context: In C/C++ and other code, `NULL` appears as a null pointer value, especially in assignments, return values, or conditional checks; this is the most consistent and strongest trigger.

patterns.name: Null-pointer cleanup or failure handling
patterns.context: An early return after a null-pointer check, or returning null during resource cleanup or parse failure; consistent with the NULL pattern but includes specific control-flow or error-handling contexts.
patterns.domain: C/C++ resource management, event handling, parsing code, and explanatory comments

patterns.name: Other short code token fragments
patterns.context: These tokens occur in different code identifiers, type names, or API names; the samples alone do not show them forming an independent, consistent trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Multiple programming languages and project code

0_1668.description: 所有片段都激活于含 NULL 的源码或注释，最强标记集中在 NULL；常见语境是空指针赋值、返回、比较及失败处理。其余标记零散，未显示独立规律。

patterns.name: NULL 常量赋值、返回或比较
patterns.context: C/C++ 等代码中，`NULL` 作为指针空值出现，尤其是赋值、返回值或条件判断；这是最一致、激活最强的触发形式。

patterns.name: 空指针相关的清理或失败处理
patterns.trigger: `if(m_data==NULL) return;`、`if (args == NULL) return;`、`a NULL is returned`
patterns.context: 空指针检查后提前返回，或在资源释放、解析失败等情境中返回空值；与 NULL 模式一致，但包含具体控制流或错误处理语境。
patterns.domain: C/C++ 资源管理、事件处理、解析代码及说明注释

patterns.name: 代码中的其他短 token 片段
patterns.context: 这些 token 出现在不同代码标识符、类型名或 API 名中；单凭所给样本看不出它们构成独立且一致的触发条件。
patterns.domain: 多种编程语言与项目代码

en.description: All segments highlight NULL: mostly pointer initialization, assignment, or return values, as well as null checks and documentation. Other weak activation markers are scattered across project code and show no consistent pattern.

patterns.name: NULL initialization or assignment
patterns.context: NULL appears in pointer initialization, assignment, or function-return positions, often next to variable declarations, cleanup code, or error handling; this is the most prominent shared trigger

patterns.name: NULL as a return value
patterns.context: A function returns NULL on failure, when there is no result, or on an early-exit path

patterns.name: Null-pointer check
patterns.context: Checks whether a pointer is null before cleanup or early return; activation also covers negated check forms

patterns.name: Code identifiers and syntax fragments
patterns.context: Identifiers, types, or syntax fragments in the same code contexts also activate weakly, but have no stable shared semantics; it is unclear whether they form an independent pattern
patterns.domain: Multiple programming languages and project code

patterns.name: NULL in documentation
patterns.context: Explanatory text states that NULL is returned when input does not meet requirements, rather than appearing in an executable statement

0_1668.description: 所有段都突出 NULL：多为指针初始化、赋值或返回值，也见空值检查与文档说明。其他弱激活标记分散在各项目代码中，未呈现一致模式。

patterns.name: NULL 初始化或赋值
patterns.context: NULL 出现在指针初始化、赋值或函数返回位置，常紧邻变量声明、清理代码或错误处理；这是最突出的共同触发

patterns.name: NULL 作为返回值
patterns.context: 函数在失败、无结果或提前退出路径中返回 NULL

patterns.name: 指针空值检查

patterns.name: 历史劳动者称谓
patterns.context: 比较历史时期劳动者的工作时长时出现，非法律论述。

patterns.name: 奇幻设定中的劳动者

patterns.name: 组织名称中的复合词尾

en.description: All fragments activate near the consumer/consumers word forms, with especially stable concentration on umers in the split spelling « Cons»«umers»; singular and plural forms, capitalization variants, and generic or organization-name contexts all occur.

patterns.name: Consumers subword boundary
patterns.context: High activation concentrates on umers in the two space-separated parts Cons and umers; the preceding Cons is often capitalized, together forming Consumers. Occurs in legal, review, email, patent, and other texts.

patterns.name: consumer(s) variants
patterns.context: The same root appears as lowercase singular or uppercase singular, without a clear Cons/umers subword boundary; related contexts still refer to consumers or consumer groups.
patterns.domain: News reviews, legal and policy emails, patent backgrounds

patterns.name: Consumer as part of an organization name
patterns.context: Consumer(s) is part of an organization name rather than a generic reference to consumers; activation still falls on the ending umers.

patterns.name: Consumers referring generically to consumers
patterns.context: Consumers as a plural group appear as sentence subjects or affiliated groups, in discussions of their awareness, responsibility, preferences, electricity use, or device use.
patterns.domain: Online reviews, news emails, patent backgrounds

0_1940.description: 所有片段都在 consumer/consumers 词形附近激活，尤其稳定集中于被拆分书写的 « Cons»«umers» 中的 umers；单复数、大小写及泛指或机构名语境均有出现。

patterns.name: Consumers 的分词边界
patterns.context: 高激活集中在被空格分开的 Cons 与 umers 两部分中的 umers；前面的 Cons 常大写，整体组成 Consumers。出现在法律、评论、邮件、专利等多种文本中。

patterns.name: consumer(s) 的变体
patterns.context: 同一词根以小写单数或大写单数出现，但没有明显的 Cons/umers 分词边界；相关上下文仍指消费者或消费者团体。
patterns.domain: 新闻评论、法律与政策邮件、专利背景

patterns.name: Consumer 作为组织名组成部分
patterns.context: Consumer(s) 是机构名称的一部分，而非泛指消费者；激活仍落在词尾 umers 上。

patterns.name: Consumers 泛指消费者
patterns.context: 复数消费者作为句子主语或所属群体，讨论其意识、责任、偏好、用电或设备使用。
patterns.domain: 网络评论、新闻邮件、专利背景

en.description: Activation concentrates on the word consumer and its singular form, especially consumers as parties to market transactions, buyers, or groups needing protection; contexts span legal, policy, business, and technology discussions.

patterns.name: Consumers as purchasers of goods or services
patterns.context: Consumers are the parties who buy or use goods or services, often appearing in discussions of transactions, payments, markets, or products
patterns.domain: Legal, policy, business, and technology discussions

patterns.name: Consumer protection and victim contexts
patterns.context: Consumers are described as a group needing protection or potentially affected by fraud or infringement
patterns.domain: Legal rulings, regulatory texts, and EU policy texts

patterns.name: Sales or market supply aimed at consumers
patterns.context: Discusses businesses providing products, services, or payment methods to consumers, or selling products to them

0_1940.description: 激活集中在消费者一词及其单数形式，尤其是消费者作为市场交易对象、购买者或需受保护群体；语境横跨法律、政策、商业与科技讨论。

patterns.name: 消费者作为商品或服务购买者
patterns.context: 消费者是购买、使用商品或服务的一方，常出现在交易、支付、市场或产品讨论中
patterns.domain: 法律、政策、商业及科技讨论

patterns.name: 消费者保护与受害者语境
patterns.context: 消费者被描述为需要保护、可能受欺诈或侵权影响的群体
patterns.domain: 法律判决、监管与欧盟政策文本

patterns.name: 面向消费者的销售或市场供给
patterns.context: 谈及企业向消费者提供产品、服务、支付方式，或把产品卖给消费者

en.description: The most stable trigger is subscribers, present across all fragments; subscriber, subscription, and split word forms also occur in subscription contexts. A few neighboring words activate sporadically, with no confirmed shared pattern.

patterns.name: Prefix adjacent to subscribers
patterns.context: The word itself is marked as the strongest activation; preceding text may include modifiers such as “community for,” “paying,” or “one hundred and fifty,” and it may appear mid-sentence or at the end.
patterns.domain: Subscription services, publishing, communications, gaming, and business texts

patterns.name: Singular subscriber variant
patterns.context: The singular form appears in a description of subscribers having multiple roles.

patterns.name: Nearby subscription word form
patterns.context: Occurs with fee in a patent background describing how users gain access to a voice messaging system; the activation token is subscribers, not subscription.

patterns.name: sub as an internal subword fragment
patterns.context: The term news site is split into sub and scription; the immediately following subscribers is marked, possibly due to subscription semantics or word form.

patterns.name: Other activated words adjacent to subscribers
patterns.context: These marked words occur in a few fragments and concern event promotions, basketball games, gaming, code, advertising, text-message subscriptions, or customer-service privacy; they do not recur consistently across fragments and are mostly adjacent to core subscriber contexts.
patterns.domain: Emails, patents, games, code, news, and customer service texts

0_1940.description: 最稳定的触发是 subscribers，覆盖全部片段；subscriber、subscription 及拆分词形也出现于订阅语境。少数相邻词激活零散，无法确认是同一规律。

patterns.name: subscribers 紧邻前缀
patterns.context: 该词本身被标记为最强激活；前文可有“community for”“paying”“one hundred and fifty”等修饰，也可位于句中或句末。
patterns.domain: 订阅服务、出版、通信、游戏及商业文本

patterns.name: 单数 subscriber 变体
patterns.context: 单数形式出现在订户拥有多个角色的说明中。

patterns.name: subscription 词形邻近
patterns.context: 与 fee 连用，出现在说明用户如何获得语音消息系统访问权的专利背景中；激活 token 是 subscribers，而非 subscription。

patterns.name: sub 作为词内分片
patterns.context: news site 一词被拆分为 sub 与 scription；紧接着的 subscribers 被标记，可能与订阅语义或词形有关。
patterns.domain: 商业邮件、新闻网站宣传

patterns.name: 与订户相邻的其他激活词
patterns.context: 这些标记词分布于少数片段，分别涉及会议宣传、篮球赛事、游戏、代码、广告、短信订阅或客服隐私；它们并未跨片段稳定复现，且多与核心订户语境相邻。
patterns.domain: 邮件、专利、游戏、代码、新闻与客服文本

en.description: Activation concentrates on subscribers, covering content and publication subscribers, communications and gaming service users, event listeners, advertising system targets, and mobile carrier users; the specific referent varies by domain.

patterns.name: Paid/content service subscribers
patterns.context: Users subscribed to websites, news, information, or other services, often adjacent to paying, community, exclusive information, news, or privacy
patterns.domain: Business emails, website promotions, and news services

patterns.name: Supporters of subscribed publications
patterns.context: Readers who support or subscribe to a publication; mentions lecture publication, endorsement, and numbers

patterns.name: Communications system users
patterns.context: Users who can access a voice messaging system using a personal identifier, appearing in a description of subscriber-to-subscriber messaging

patterns.name: Massively multiplayer online game subscribers
patterns.context: Monthly subscribers to MMORPGs, mentioned alongside characters, multiplayer gaming, and game activities

patterns.name: Event subscribers/listeners
patterns.context: Program objects that register for custom events to receive notifications when an event is triggered

patterns.name: Advertising system service targets
patterns.context: A patent system or method provides outdoor advertising services to subscribers

patterns.name: Mobile carrier users
patterns.context: Listed alongside Philippine carriers Globe, Smart, and Sun; refers to mobile users who can receive text-message alerts

0_1940.description: 激活集中在 subscribers，涵盖内容及出版订阅者、通信和游戏服务用户、事件监听者、广告系统对象及移动运营商用户；具体所指随领域变化。

patterns.name: 付费/内容服务订户
patterns.context: 指订阅网站、新闻、信息或其他服务的用户，常与 paying、community、exclusive information、news、privacy 等相邻
patterns.domain: 商业邮件、网站宣传与新闻服务

patterns.name: 订阅出版物的支持者
patterns.context: 指为出版物提供支持或订阅的读者，提及讲座出版、endorsement 与人数

patterns.name: 通信系统用户
patterns.context: 指可通过个人标识符使用语音消息系统的用户，出现在 subscriber-to-subscriber messaging 描述中

patterns.name: 多人在线游戏订户
patterns.context: 指 MMORPG 的月度订户，并与角色、多人游戏及游戏活动并列

patterns.name: 事件订阅者/监听者
patterns.context: 指向自定义事件注册、以便事件触发时通知的程序对象

patterns.name: 广告系统服务对象
patterns.context: 专利系统或方法面向订户提供户外广告服务

patterns.name: 移动运营商用户
patterns.context: 与菲律宾运营商 Globe、Smart、Sun 并列，指可接收短信提醒的手机用户

en.description: Strongly responds to contexts involving consumers and their transactions, rights, risk of victimization, and market identity; covers commercial transactions, legal protection, market groups, and end consumption.

patterns.name: Consumers as purchasers of goods or services
patterns.context: In discussions of electricity, payments, products, or services, consumers are buyers, electricity users, or parties whose price certainty is discussed.
patterns.domain: Business, energy, and payment industry texts

patterns.name: Consumers as subjects of legal protection or litigation
patterns.context: Consumers are described as subjects of regulatory protection, victims in class actions, or people who may be misled by commercial practices.

patterns.name: Consumers as a market group
patterns.context: Consumers are treated as a group affected by counterfeit goods, or as the consumer market of a particular country or region.

patterns.name: Consumers as end buyers
patterns.context: Describes a production-consumption chain in which resources are made into short-lived goods and sold, with consumers continuing to buy them.
patterns.domain: Online reviews and critiques of consumerism

0_1940.description: 对消费者及其买卖、权益、受害风险与市场身份相关语境强烈响应；覆盖商业交易、法律保护、市场群体和终端消费等用法。

patterns.name: 消费者作为商品或服务的购买者
patterns.context: 在电力、支付、产品或服务等讨论中，消费者是购买方、用电方，或被讨论价格确定性的一方。
patterns.domain: 商业、能源与支付行业文本

patterns.name: 消费者作为法律保护或诉讼对象
patterns.context: 消费者被描述为受监管保护的对象、集体诉讼中的受害者，或可能受商业行为误导的人。

patterns.name: 消费者作为市场群体
patterns.context: 将消费者作为受假冒商品影响的群体，或描述特定国家／地区的消费者市场。

patterns.name: 消费者作为终端买家

en.concept: Slash comment markers in code and markup
en.description: Primarily responds strongly to the double-slash sequence “//”: this includes both code comments and HTML declarations or slashes in garbled text. Also responds to the Java documentation comment opener “/**”; the commonality is that slashes form comment or markup symbols.

patterns.name: Double-slash comment opener
patterns.context: Appears at the start of double-slash comments in code or documents; the following content may be ordinary explanation, labels, or comment text.
patterns.domain: Github source code, configuration, and documentation

patterns.name: Double slashes in an HTML declaration
patterns.context: Located in the PUBLIC identifier of an HTML doctype declaration, as part of a W3C identifier rather than a code comment.

patterns.name: Slashes in anomalous or corrupted text
patterns.context: Appears in hard-to-read, possibly garbled or malformed text; no identifiable comment or markup context.

patterns.name: Javadoc documentation comment
patterns.context: At the start of a documentation comment before a Java method, followed by @see, a method description, and @Override.

0_1940.concept: 代码与标记中的斜线注释符
0_1940.description: 主要对双斜线序列“//”强烈响应：既包括代码注释，也包括 HTML 声明和乱码中的斜线。另对 Java 文档注释起始符“/**”响应；各处共同点是斜线构成的注释或标记符号。

patterns.name: 双斜线注释起始符
patterns.context: 出现在代码或文档中的双斜线注释起始位置；其后的内容可以是普通说明、标签或注释正文。
patterns.domain: Github 源代码、配置和文档

patterns.name: HTML 声明中的双斜线
patterns.context: 位于 HTML doctype 声明的 PUBLIC 标识符中，处于 W3C 标识符的一部分，而非代码注释。

patterns.name: 异常或损坏文本中的斜线
patterns.context: 出现在难以辨认、疑似乱码或格式损坏的文本中；缺少可确认的注释或标记语境。

patterns.name: Javadoc 文档注释
patterns.context: 位于 Java 方法前的文档注释开头，后接 @see、方法说明及 @Override。

en.description: The strongest and most consistent trigger is the double slash “//” in source code or text, commonly used as a line-comment opener; it also occurs in HTML declarations and mixed text. The following comment content varies, and project description text also appears.

patterns.name: Double-slash comment opener
patterns.context: Appears in source code as a line-comment opener; it may also occur in the PUBLIC identifier of an HTML DOCTYPE or be joined to following comment text.

patterns.name: Code comment content
patterns.context: Double slashes are followed by source-code explanations, build instructions, copyright, licenses, or descriptions of default behavior.

patterns.name: Double slashes in strings and mixed text
patterns.context: Double slashes occur in garbled text or the PUBLIC identifier of an HTML DOCTYPE, rather than in an ordinary line comment.

patterns.name: Protocol name after a comment marker
patterns.context: Double slashes are followed by project description text rather than obvious comment content or a URL.

0_1940.description: 最强且一致的触发是源码或文本中的双斜线“//”，常作行注释起始符；也出现在 HTML 声明及混杂文本中。后续注释内容多样，另有项目说明文本。

patterns.name: 双斜线注释起始符
patterns.context: 出现在源码中作为行注释起始符；也可能位于 HTML DOCTYPE 的 PUBLIC 标识符中，或与后续注释内容相连。

patterns.name: 代码注释内容
patterns.trigger: «//»10 cgo -«god»1«efs»1 types_dar；«//»10 syscall；«//»10 newline；«//»10 SPDX-License-«Identifier»2:« GPL»1；«//»10« Copyright»1；«//»10« Licensed»1；«//»10 default behavior is to do« nothing»1
patterns.context: 双斜线后跟源码说明、构建指令、版权、许可证或对默认行为的描述。

patterns.name: 字符串中的双斜线及混杂文本
patterns.context: 双斜线出现在乱码或 HTML DOCTYPE 的 PUBLIC 标识符中，并非普通行注释。
patterns.domain: 法律语料乱码、HTML 声明

patterns.name: 注释符后的协议名称
patterns.trigger: «//»10 Protocol Buff«ers»5 for Go with« Gad»1gets
patterns.context: 双斜线后接项目说明文字，而非明显的注释内容或 URL。

en.description: The most stable cue is the double slash // in source code or markup text, usually as a comment opener; it also occurs in HTML public identifiers. A few subword fragments appear sporadically and are difficult to explain within the main pattern.

patterns.name: Double-slash comment opener
patterns.context: Double slashes appear in code or markup, often as a comment opener; they may also be embedded in the public identifier of an HTML doctype.

patterns.name: Slashes in an HTML public identifier
patterns.context: Appears in the public identifier of an HTML 4 document type declaration, not as a comment.

patterns.name: Sporadic code subword fragments
patterns.context: These subword fragments each occur in different code identifiers or syntax structures; beyond co-occurring with double slashes, they show no clear shared trigger.
patterns.domain: Legal texts and source code in multiple programming languages

0_1940.description: 最稳定的线索是源码或标记文本中的双斜杠 //，多作注释起始符；另有 HTML 公共标识中的 //。少数词片段分散出现，难与主模式统一解释。

patterns.name: 双斜杠注释起始符
patterns.context: 代码或标记语言中出现双斜杠，常作为注释起始符；也可能嵌在 HTML doctype 的公共标识中。

patterns.name: HTML 公共标识中的斜杠
patterns.context: 出现在 HTML 4 文档类型声明的公共标识中，不是注释。

patterns.name: 零散代码词片段
patterns.context: 这些词片段各自处于不同代码标识符或语法结构中；除与双斜杠共现外，没有明显一致的触发条件。
patterns.domain: 法律文本及多种编程语言源码

en.description: All fragments strongly activate on Users or users, referring to groups of people who use something; syntactic roles and domains vary, and uses in product names and email labels also occur. Neighboring words vary and show no stable additional trigger.

patterns.name: Users as the head noun
patterns.context: The forms Users and users often occur as subjects, objects, or in prepositional phrases, referring to users, accounts, or user groups; activation is not dependent on a single domain.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain expository text, news, technical documentation, and emails

patterns.name: Users as subjects or agents
patterns.context: Users is followed by a modal or linking verb, describing what users can, may, must, or are permitted to do.
patterns.domain: Technical documentation, patent backgrounds, software documentation

patterns.name: User groups and customer relationships
patterns.context: Users refers to groups using a particular product, service, or experiment; it can also describe churn or user categories.

patterns.name: Users in a brand or product name
patterns.context: Users is part of a proper name or product label, appearing in HTML/XML-style code.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A and markup code

patterns.name: Mailing list or recipient label
patterns.context: Users appears as a brief salutation or category label in email body text.

patterns.name: Lowercase users form
patterns.context: Also refers to users, but appears lowercase within a sentence; it is similar to the main capitalized form, with slightly weaker activation.

patterns.name: Adjacent words or formatting may affect activation
patterns.context: These words appear next to the target in individual fragments but are inconsistent across fragments; they may reflect local contextual effects and do not establish an independent trigger pattern.

0_1940.description: 所有片段都强烈激活于 Users 或 users，指人的用户群体；句法角色和领域多样，另见产品名、邮件标签等用法。邻近词各异，未显示稳定的额外触发词。

patterns.name: Users 作名词中心词
patterns.context: 大小写形式为 Users，常处在主语、宾语或介词短语中，指使用者、账户或用户群体；触发不依赖单一领域。
patterns.domain: 跨领域说明文、新闻、技术文档和邮件

patterns.name: 用户作为主语或行动者
patterns.trigger: « Users»10 can；« Users»10 may；« Users»10 must；« Users»10 are
patterns.context: Users 后接情态动词或系动词，描述用户能够、可以、必须或被允许做某事。
patterns.domain: 技术说明、专利背景、软件文档

patterns.name: 用户群体及客户关系
patterns.context: Users 指特定产品、服务或实验的使用者群体，也可描述其流失或身份类别。
patterns.domain: 论坛、商务邮件、科研文本

patterns.name: 品牌或产品名中的 Users
patterns.context: Users 是专名或产品标签的一部分，出现在 HTML/XML 风格的代码中。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答及标记语言代码

patterns.name: 邮件列表或收件人标签
patterns.context: Users 出现在邮件正文的简短称呼或分类标签中。

patterns.name: 小写 users 形式
patterns.context: 同样指用户，但以小写形式出现在句中；与主要的首字母大写形式近似，激活稍弱。

patterns.name: 相邻词或格式可能影响激活
patterns.context: 这些词在个别片段中紧邻目标词，但跨段不一致；它们可能是局部上下文影响，不能据此确立独立触发模式。

en.description: All fragments activate on Users/users, including embedded capitalization variants; the referent varies by context, including ordinary users, specific user categories, or interface labels. Surrounding topics and styles are diverse.

patterns.name: Plural noun Users
patterns.context: The form Users/users appears in noun phrases or sentences, often as an agent, an affiliated category, or a party being served; capitalization is not fixed
patterns.domain: Various styles, including news, papers, emails, code, patents, and web markup

patterns.name: Virtual currency risk warning

patterns.name: Account of Orkut user churn
patterns.context: Describes users leaving the service because of slow response; preceding text discusses Orkut infrastructure and product design

patterns.name: User operation control module
patterns.context: Introduces a control module and explains that users can operate resources

patterns.name: Virtual world user connection
patterns.context: Users choose to connect to virtual world instances hosted by machines in different locations

patterns.name: Master Users customer outreach
patterns.context: Contact Master Users at major customers after approval

patterns.name: AOL Users unsubscribe link
patterns.context: AOL Users appears as a label in a web email, near an unsubscribe URL and HTML link

patterns.name: Users in a code comment
patterns.context: Discusses whether users can exert a certain influence or are allowed to modify a privilege flag; activation occurs in a kernel code comment

patterns.name: PrimeFaces Users label

patterns.name: Zoom-related words
patterns.context: The word itself contains zoom and concerns zoom functions, microscopy/holography, mobile web, or camera lenses; variant prefixes or suffixes also trigger activation.

patterns.name: beginnings 词形
patterns.trigger: «beginnings»10；另有 «beginnings»10 前的语境分别出现 “go back to its… and start”, “had its…”, “the… of”, “From these…”, “beer’s…”
patterns.context: 直接触发词为 beginnings；前后文将其用于某事物的起源、早期阶段或发展开端，涵盖明确所属关系及抽象的“the beginnings of”结构。
patterns.domain: 文学评论、专利背景、地理历史、经济史、技术描述、啤酒文化；段落文体多样

patterns.name: portrayed 词形
patterns.trigger: «portrayed»9；分别为 “are portrayed as” 和 “as is being portrayed…”，以及 “as portrayed by”
patterns.context: 出现过去分词 portrayed，表示某人或事物被描绘、呈现或描述；句法既有被动式，也有后置修饰语。
patterns.domain: HackerNews评论、哲学论文摘要、娱乐人物介绍

en.description: Strong activation centers on two English word forms: the noun beginnings (origins, beginnings) and the past participle portrayed (depicted, presented). Although they occur across varied styles, both are triggered by specific lexical items.

patterns.name: Form and meaning of beginnings
patterns.context: The word is a noun meaning the origin or early stages of something; it is often preceded by a possessive, demonstrative, or prepositional phrase (e.g., “its beginnings,” “the beginnings,” “these beginnings,” “beer’s beginnings”).
patterns.domain: Literary criticism, patent backgrounds, encyclopedia history, popular explanations, technical and beer articles

patterns.name: Participle form portrayed
patterns.context: The past participle appears in passive or postpositive modifier constructions, referring to a person or thing being depicted or presented; it occurs in structures such as “are portrayed as being” and “as portrayed in/by.”
patterns.domain: Online comments, philosophy papers, entertainment profiles

0_1989.description: 强激活集中在两个英文词形：名词 beginnings（起源、开端）及过去分词 portrayed（被描绘、呈现）；虽跨多种文体，均由具体词项触发。

patterns.name: beginnings 的词形与语义
patterns.context: 该词作为名词，表示某事物的起源或早期阶段；前面常见所有格、指示语或介词短语（如“its beginnings”“the beginnings”“these beginnings”“beer’s beginnings”）。
patterns.domain: 文学评论、专利背景、百科历史、通俗说明、技术与啤酒文章

patterns.name: portrayed 的分词形式
patterns.context: 过去分词用于被动或后置修饰结构，指人物或事物被描绘、呈现；分别出现在“are portrayed as being”和“as portrayed in/by”等结构中。
patterns.domain: 网络评论、哲学论文、娱乐人物介绍

en.description: The primary response is to beginnings (discussing the origin or beginning of something), with a strong response also to portrayed (describing how an object is presented). The two word types occur in different contexts and styles, with no clear shared semantics.

patterns.name: High activation for the noun beginnings
patterns.context: The word form beginnings appears whether referring abstractly to the beginning of something or discussing the origin of a practice, network, geographical route, literary form, or beer; it often follows a preposition or determiner.
patterns.domain: Literary criticism, patent backgrounds, encyclopedias, popular science, and general online text

patterns.name: Depicted or presented as
patterns.context: Describes how an object is presented as a certain kind of thing in a work or narrative, often in structures such as “are portrayed as” or “as portrayed by/in”; subjects may be dangerous things, people, or individuals.
patterns.domain: Game reviews, philosophy papers, entertainment reporting

0_1989.description: 主要响应 beginnings（谈论事物的起源或开端），也强烈响应 portrayed（描述对象如何被呈现）。两类词出现在不同语境与文体中，未见明确共同语义。

patterns.name: 名词 beginnings 的高激活
patterns.context: 词形 beginnings 出现时，无论是抽象地指某事物的开端，还是具体讨论某实践、网络、地理路线、文学形式或啤酒的起源；常位于介词或限定语之后。
patterns.domain: 文学评论、专利背景、百科、科普及一般网络文本

patterns.name: 被描绘、呈现为
patterns.context: 描述某对象在作品或叙述中被呈现成某种样子，常见结构为“are portrayed as”或“as portrayed by/in”；主语可为危险事物、人物或个人。
patterns.domain: 游戏评论、哲学论文、娱乐报道

en.description: Two clear lexical triggers: beginnings appears in accounts of origins across various fields; portrayed appears in descriptions of how people, things, or ideas are presented. The shared theme is origins or presentation, but the lexical triggers themselves are more definite.

patterns.name: beginning(s) word form
patterns.context: The word appears in sentences about the origin, early stages, or historical roots of something; activation falls directly on the word.
patterns.domain: Literary criticism, patent backgrounds, geographical history, economic history, technology, beer introductions, and other styles

patterns.name: Depiction of people or things with portrayed
patterns.context: Describes how people, dangerous things, or ideas are presented or depicted; activation falls on portrayed.
patterns.domain: Online comments, philosophy papers, music profiles

0_1989.description: 两组清晰词汇触发：beginnings 出现在多领域的起源叙述中；portrayed 出现在对人物、事物或观念如何被呈现的描述中。共同点是涉及事物的起源或呈现方式，但词汇触发本身更明确。

patterns.name: beginning(s) 词形
patterns.context: 该词出现在谈论事物起源、早期阶段或历史源头的句子中；激活直接落在该词上。
patterns.domain: 文学评论、专利背景、地理史、经济史、技术、啤酒介绍等多种文体

patterns.name: portrayed 的人物或事物刻画
patterns.context: 描述人物、危险事物或思想概念被呈现、刻画的方式；激活落在 portrayed 上。
patterns.domain: 网络评论、哲学论文、音乐人物介绍

en.description: All passages activate at the English word “portrayed,” across contexts involving the depiction of dangerous things, financial circumstances, ideas, tribute works, romantic relationships, actors playing roles, fiscal conditions, event images, stage roles, and popular-culture images.

patterns.name: People/relationships depicted or presented
patterns.context: The word appears in descriptions of how people, individuals, relationships, or things are presented, depicted, or played; it is sometimes followed by as, in, or by, and can also directly take an object.
patterns.domain: Reviews, academic discussion, profiles of people and works, news reports

0_1989.description: 所有段都在英语词“portrayed”处激活，涵盖描写危险事物、财富状况、思想观念、致敬作品、恋爱关系、演员饰演角色、财政状况、赛事形象、舞台角色及流行文化形象等语境。

patterns.name: 人物/关系被刻画或呈现
patterns.context: 该词出现在对人物、个体、关系或事物如何呈现、描绘、扮演的描述中；有时后接 as、in、by，也可直接接宾语。
patterns.domain: 评论、学术论述、人物与作品介绍、新闻报道

en.concept: Word-initial beginnings and the furnish stem
en.description: Activation is concentrated on the beginning of beginnings and the stem of furnish: the former occurs in contexts about origins or early stages, while the latter means to provide, equip, or deliver, and also matches the stem within furnishings.

patterns.name: Beginning of beginnings
patterns.context: The word appears as a noun, usually referring to the origin, early stages, or beginning of something; it is preceded by a possessive, definite article, or “these,” and followed by an “of” phrase or other explanation.
patterns.domain: Literary criticism, patent backgrounds, encyclopedias, general explanatory prose

patterns.name: furnish stem
patterns.context: Means to provide, equip, or deliver something; includes the infinitive “to furnish,” the base form “furnish,” and the substring within “furnishings.”
patterns.domain: Mathematics papers, bankruptcy or legal documents

0_1989.concept: 词首 beginnings 与词干 furnish
0_1989.description: 激活集中在 beginnings 的词首及 furnish 的词干：前者出现在谈及起源或早期阶段的语境，后者表示提供、配备或交付，亦命中 furnishings 内的词干。

patterns.name: beginnings 的词首
patterns.context: 该词作为名词出现，通常指某事物的起源、早期阶段或开端；前有所有格、定冠词或“these”，后接“of”短语或其他说明。
patterns.domain: 文学评论、专利背景、百科、一般说明文

patterns.name: furnish 的词干
patterns.context: 表示提供、配备或交付某物；包括不定式“to furnish”、原形“furnish”和“furnishings”的词内子串。
patterns.domain: 数学论文、破产或法律文书

en.description: The clearest activations correspond to several unrelated word-form fragments: reate in create, the full word witnessing, and inguish in extinguish. Witnessing occurs across varied semantics and styles and cannot be assigned a single meaning.

patterns.name: Word-form fragment create
patterns.context: The trigger is the continuous character sequence reate within the word create, with the initial letter G appearing in the preceding segment; the contexts are a game review and a natural-gas trading email.

patterns.name: Word form witnessing
patterns.context: Triggers the full word witnessing; its semantic role and setting vary, including personally experiencing an event, observing, or a market undergoing a phenomenon.
patterns.domain: Philosophical texts, patent backgrounds, encyclopedia narratives, technical Q&A, personal essays, market reports, medical abstracts

patterns.name: Word-form fragment extinguish
patterns.context: Triggers the internal fragment inguish in the word extinguish, in a list of tasks describing rescue teams extinguishing a spreading fire.

0_1989.description: 激活最明显地对应若干不相连的词形片段：create 的 reate、witnessing 全词、extinguish 的 inguish。witnessing 跨多种语义与文体出现，不能归为单一含义。

patterns.name: 词形片段 create
patterns.context: 触发点是单词 create 中的连续字符片段 reate，前一段还出现词首 G；上下文分别是游戏评论和天然气交易邮件。

patterns.name: 词形 witnessing
patterns.context: 触发完整词 witnessing；语义角色和场景各异，可指亲历事件、观察或市场正在经历某现象。
patterns.domain: 哲学文本、专利背景、百科叙述、技术问答、个人随笔、市场报告、医学摘要

patterns.name: 词形片段 extinguish
patterns.context: 触发单词 extinguish 的词内片段 inguish，位于描述救援队扑灭蔓延火灾的并列任务中。

en.concept: spread/Sheets word forms and local word fragments
en.description: The strongest response is to Spread followed by sheet/Sheets, and also to ordinary spread, technical terms, and -reate embedded in a word. Several other scattered words and symbols activate, but are difficult to explain consistently.

patterns.name: Spreadsheet product name and component words
patterns.context: “Spread” is adjacent to “sheet” or forms “Sheets,” appearing in product names, APIs, function names, or as a common noun.

patterns.name: spread as a common word or technical term
patterns.context: Appears in expressions such as “spread the ...,” “Thermal Spread,” “Spread Spectrum,” or “Spreadubuntu,” not as a Google Sheets name.

patterns.name: Word-final fragment -reate
patterns.context: Activation falls on the internal word fragment “reate”; in [1] it occurs in “Great(e),” and in [2] in word forms such as “create.”

patterns.name: deal and preceding context
patterns.context: Adjacent to business transaction contexts such as sale, price scenarios, and for each.

patterns.name: with
patterns.context: Used as a preposition connecting objects or material phrases; in this sample it occurs in transaction emails, recipes, and papers.

patterns.name: Other sporadic word-form activations
patterns.context: Each word or symbol occurs locally in just one passage, with insufficient evidence to assign them to a shared trigger pattern.
patterns.domain: Forums, recipes, academic texts, IRC, patents, Q&A, and code

0_1989.description: 主要对 Spread 及其后接 sheet/Sheets 的词形强烈响应，也见于普通 spread、技术术语和嵌入词中的 -reate；另有若干分散词、符号激活，难以统一解释。

patterns.name: spreadsheet 产品名及其组成词
patterns.context: “Spread”紧邻“sheet”或形成“Sheets”，出现在产品名称、API、函数名或一般名词中。

patterns.name: spread 作为普通词或技术术语
patterns.context: 出现在“spread the ...”“Thermal Spread”“Spread Spectrum”或“Spreadubuntu”等表达中，并非 Google Sheets 名称。

patterns.name: 词尾片段 -reate
patterns.context: 激活落在单词内部的“reate”片段；[1] 中为“Great(e)”，[2] 中为“create”一类词形。

patterns.name: deal 及其前置语境
patterns.context: 与 sale、price scenarios、for each 等商务交易语境相邻。

patterns.name: with
patterns.context: 作为介词连接对象或材料短语；本样本中分别处于交易邮件和食谱、论文语境。

patterns.name: 其他零散词形激活
patterns.context: 各词或符号只在单段局部出现，缺少足够证据归为共同触发模式。
patterns.domain: 论坛、食谱、学术文本、IRC、专利、问答与代码

en.description: All passages prominently feature “trapped” and related meanings of confinement and entrapment, involving abstract states, physical particles, trapped people, and ions; various neighboring words or local substrings also activate and may have different sources.

patterns.name: Objects that are trapped, confined, or stuck
patterns.context: An object cannot escape freely because of a local minimum, matrix, potential barrier, field, phase state, or other constraint; also includes people or ions literally trapped.
patterns.domain: Machine learning, astrochemistry, condensed-matter and plasma physics, rescue, quantum physics

patterns.name: Local triggers within word forms
patterns.context: Activation falls on substrings within words that do not correspond to independent meanings; the available fragments are insufficient to determine whether the trigger is the full word or nearby context.

patterns.name: Identifiability and concessive connection
patterns.context: Appear respectively in a sentence where a molecule is explicitly identified and one where a theoretical study proposes another possibility; their relation to the theme of “trapped” is uncertain.

patterns.name: Emphasis on features or similarity
patterns.context: Describes model features and properties shared with other systems; does not form an obvious entrapment theme.

patterns.name: Words related to traps, centers, and charge transfer
patterns.context: Discusses traps in silica or at interfaces, followed by charge transfer; “traps” is semantically related to capture/entrapment, while the other triggers are unclear.
patterns.domain: Materials physics, defects, and charge processes

patterns.name: Abandonment in a narrative and intensified outcome
patterns.context: A first-person account describes an expanding investigation, eventually ceasing the pursuit and saying “became trapped”; several non-entrapment words also activate.

patterns.name: Particle motion and Earth's magnetic field
patterns.context: Describes trapped particles orbiting along Earth's magnetic field lines; the core word “trapped” and additional physical-description words activate.

patterns.name: Turbulence and interactions
patterns.context: Introduces unstable modes, nonlinear three-wave interactions, and turbulence in collisionless trapped-electron modes; some activated words are not synonyms for entrapment.

patterns.name: Phase transitions and glassy states
patterns.context: A vortex liquid bypasses the crystalline phase and becomes trapped in a metastable polymer-like glassy state; these words are adjacent to the trapped state.

patterns.name: Trapped victims and rescue actions
patterns.context: Multiple agents simultaneously explore, rescue trapped victims, and extinguish a spreading fire; activation covers deployment, parallel actions, and firefighting vocabulary.

patterns.name: Quantum magnetism and ion traps
patterns.context: Background on progress in quantum magnetism mentions trapped ions; “trapped” is a domain-specific term.

0_1989.description: 各段共同突出“trapped”及相关的困住、陷阱语义，涉及抽象状态、物理粒子、受困者和离子；同时有多种邻近词或局部子串激活，来源未必相同。

patterns.name: 被困、滞留或受困的对象
patterns.context: 对象因局部极小值、基质、势垒、场、相态或其他限制而无法自由离开；也包括字面上受困的人或离子。
patterns.domain: 机器学习、天体化学、凝聚态与等离子体物理、救援、量子物理

patterns.name: 词形内部的局部触发
patterns.context: 激活落在词内子串，不对应独立语义；现有片段不足以判定是否由完整词或邻近语境触发。
patterns.domain: 学术论文引文及被截断文本

patterns.name: 可识别性及让步连接
patterns.context: 分别出现在分子被明确识别、以及理论研究提出另一可能的句子中；与“trapped”的主题关系不确定。

patterns.name: 强调特征或相似性
patterns.context: 描述模型特征及其与其他系统共享的性质；不构成明显的受困语义。
patterns.domain: 长程相互作用系统论文

patterns.name: 陷阱、中心及电荷转移相关词
patterns.context: 讨论二氧化硅或界面中的陷阱，以及后续电荷转移；其中“traps”与被捕获/受困有词义关联，其余触发不明。
patterns.domain: 材料物理、缺陷与电荷过程

patterns.name: 叙述中的放弃与结果强化
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述调查范围扩张，最后停止追寻并说自己“became trapped”；多种非受困词也有激活。

patterns.name: 粒子运动与地球磁场
patterns.context: 描述被困粒子沿地球磁场线环绕；核心“trapped”与额外的物理描述词均激活。

patterns.name: 湍流与相互作用
patterns.context: 介绍不稳定模态、非线性三波相互作用及无碰撞受困电子模态湍流；部分激活词并非受困的同义表达。

patterns.name: 相变与玻璃态
patterns.context: 涡旋液体绕过晶体相后被困在亚稳的类聚合物玻璃态；这些词与受困状态相邻。

patterns.name: 受困受害者及救援动作
patterns.context: 多智能体同时探索、救援受困者并扑灭蔓延的火灾；激活涵盖部署、并行行动与灭火词汇。

patterns.name: 量子磁学与离子阱
patterns.context: 量子磁学研究进展的背景中提及被囚禁离子；“trapped”是领域术语。

en.description: Activation primarily involves two types of word forms: -ublished in republished, and screwed meaning to be in trouble (including screwed up); the remaining scattered markers lack a verifiable shared pattern.

patterns.name: Republished
patterns.context: The word-final fragment occurs in republished, meaning that a work is published again; the context often mentions books, translations, or works.

patterns.name: screwed meaning being in trouble
patterns.context: In colloquial or informal contexts, means that someone or something is in a bad situation or faces adverse consequences; it can stand alone as a predicate or occur in screwed up.
patterns.domain: Online forums, academic writing, general online text

patterns.name: Unclear shared activation feature
patterns.context: Appears in historical text about Eminent Saxon prelate Ælfric; it is not the same local word form as the republished pattern, and the trigger is unclear.

patterns.name: Unclear sporadic word fragments
patterns.context: These fragments are scattered across passages; apart from republished and screwed, the sample makes it difficult to determine whether they form independent, stable patterns.

0_1989.description: 主要激活两类词形：republished 中的 -ublished，以及表示陷入困境的 screwed（含 screwed up）；其余零散标记缺乏可确认的共同规律。

patterns.name: 再次出版
patterns.context: 词尾片段出现在 republished 一词中，语义为作品重新出版；上下文常提到书籍、译本或作品。
patterns.domain: 传记、出版史、维基百科叙述

patterns.name: screwed 表示陷入困境
patterns.context: 在口语或非正式语境中，表示某人或某事处境糟糕、遭遇不利后果；可独立作表语，也可构成 screwed up。
patterns.domain: 网络论坛、学术写作、一般网络文本

patterns.name: 不明的共同激活特征
patterns.trigger: « E»、«minent»、« Sax»、«on»、«pre»、«late»、« Æ»、«lf»、«ric» 等零散片段
patterns.context: 出现在关于 Eminent Saxon prelate Ælfric 的历史文字中，与 republished 模式并非同一局部词形，触发原因不明确。

patterns.name: 不明的零散词片段
patterns.trigger: « Bush»、« Bro»、«k»、«aw»、« cited»、« eyew»、« published»、« Discover»、«;»、« vulnerable»、« mortgage»、« sustain»、« screwed» 等标记片段
patterns.context: 这些片段分散在各段中；除 republished 与 screwed 外，难以从样本判断它们是否构成独立稳定模式。

en.description: Strong activations cluster on three word-form fragments: English plung, ún across Spanish and Portuguese (único), and English Unlock/Unlocking. They differ in meaning and domain; triggering is mainly associated with the corresponding word forms.

patterns.name: plung word family
patterns.context: The English stem plung appears in noun or verb forms, across contexts including spring mechanisms, music reviews, and economic downturns.

patterns.name: Fragment of único
patterns.context: Spanish and Portuguese único appears in sentences describing the only option, the only performer, or the only market.
patterns.domain: Multilingual European Parliament texts, Portuguese Q&A

patterns.name: Unlock word family
patterns.context: English Unlock and its derived forms occur as code method names, product features, or words in webpage text.

0_1989.description: 最强激活集中在三个词形片段：英语 plung、跨西葡语的 ún（único）以及英语 Unlock/Unlocking。它们语义与领域各异，触发条件主要是对应词形出现。

patterns.name: plung 词族
patterns.context: 英语词干 plung 出现在名词或动词词形中；涉及弹簧机构、音乐评论、经济下跌等不同语境。

patterns.name: único 的切分片段
patterns.context: 西班牙语和葡萄牙语中的 único，出现在描述唯一选项、唯一演员或唯一市场的句子中。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会多语文本、葡萄牙语问答

patterns.name: Unlock 词族
patterns.context: 英语 Unlock 及其派生形式，分别作为代码方法名、产品功能或网页文本中的词。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、科学相关网页、代码

en.description: Strong activations across all fragments fall on transplanted: describing organs, cells, tissues, or microbial communities being transplanted, implanted, or transferred to a recipient, host, or other location; the fields and objects vary.

patterns.name: Transplant/implant action verb
patterns.context: The word is used in the passive voice or past tense to describe cells, tissues, organs, microbial communities, etc. being moved into a recipient, host, or other site; strong activation falls on transplanted.

0_1989.description: 全部片段的强激活均落在 transplanted：描述器官、细胞、组织或微生物群落被移植、植入或转入受体、宿主或其他位置；专业领域与对象各异。

patterns.name: 移植/植入动作词
patterns.context: 该词用作被动语态或过去式，描述细胞、组织、器官、微生物群落等被移入受体、宿主或其他部位；强激活落在 transplanted 上。
