en.description: All passages show strong activation on forms of “transplant”; the core trigger is «transplanted». Objects include organs, cells, tissues, pancreatic islets, plant seedlings, and microbial communities, with contexts ranging from clinical outcomes to experiments and patent descriptions.

patterns.name: Transplant-related verbs
patterns.context: Indicates moving cells, tissues, organs, or microbial communities into a recipient, host, or other environment; may describe a completed transplant or occur in background on transplant research.

patterns.name: Clinical outcomes of organ transplantation and grafts
patterns.context: Clinical processes such as post-transplant recurrence, functional recovery, or removal followed by retransplantation; passage [1] also concerns kidney transplantation and grafts.

patterns.name: Plant tissue culture and transplanting
patterns.context: Somatic embryos develop into seedlings and are then moved into soil or horticultural substrate; this concerns plants, not medical transplantation.

patterns.name: Immunogenicity and rejection
patterns.context: Discusses whether the transplant host undergoes immune rejection, or reducing graft immunogenicity; the trigger remains adjacent to transplantation wording.

patterns.name: Cell or tissue transplantation experiments
patterns.context: Cells, progenitor cells, or tissue constructs are moved into animals or specific tissues to examine engraftment, osteogenesis, or other experimental outcomes.
patterns.domain: Experimental biomedicine, stem cells, and tissue engineering

patterns.name: Autologous islet transplantation
patterns.context: Autologous islet transplantation after total pancreatectomy, with discussion of the function of transplanted islets.

patterns.name: Hematopoietic system reconstitution
patterns.context: Discusses the contribution of transplanted cells to reconstitution of the recipient’s hematopoietic system and gene expression risks.

patterns.name: Microbiota transplantation
patterns.context: Discusses the potential long-term effects of transferred microbial communities on human health.

patterns.name: Comparison of kidney transplant cohorts
patterns.context: Compares clinical outcomes of adult kidney transplants from different standard-donor sources.

en.concept: Polysemous uses of put and intra-word fragments

patterns.name: Sample placement in physical experiments
patterns.context: Indicates placing a liquid sample or material in a specific apparatus, container, or experimental state.

patterns.name: Expressing importance or emphasis

patterns.name: Part of an adverbial suffix
patterns.context: The activated character sequence is embedded within “putatively”; it is not the independent verb put. The source text marks the word with quotation marks.

patterns.name: Wavelength assignment
patterns.context: Placing two circles on the same wavelength, indicating resource configuration or allocation.

patterns.context: Appears when a problem asks for a rank, magnitude, or derivative order.

0_2490.concept: 数学符号与数学任务文本
0_2490.description: 激活覆盖两类文本：论文中的公式、专业术语与引文；以及数学练习中的密集数字和运算符。练习题还反复出现计算、转换、排序、求导指令及序数、大小比较词。

patterns.name: 科学文献与引文中的数学符号
patterns.context: 出现在论文正文、公式或文献引用中；激活落在术语、公式符号及数字/引用片段上。

patterns.name: 算术题中的运算符与数值
patterns.context: 密集数字、算术表达式或计算题中，常伴随负号、乘除符号和数字串；也包括数制转换题。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 数学练习或生成式题目

patterns.name: 题目指令与数学操作词
patterns.trigger: “What is”, “Convert”, “Calculate”, “Find”, “divided by”, “in ascending order”, “decreasing order”, “third derivative”
patterns.context: 出现在要求计算、转换、排序或求导的题目提示中。

patterns.name: 序数及比较、排序语汇
patterns.context: 题目要求确定次序、大小或导数阶数时出现。

en.description: Primarily responds to instructions and phrasing about sorting and differentiation in math exercises, alongside digit strings, minus signs, and operators. A few activations occur in paper citation numbers, inequality statements, and spectroscopy values; no single trigger word explains all passages.

patterns.name: Mathematical problem instructions
patterns.context: Triggered by natural-language instructions or questions in math problems, especially sentences asking for calculation, conversion, sorting, or differentiation; often at the beginning or end of a task.
patterns.domain: Arithmetic and algebra exercises from DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Ordinal and ranking expressions
patterns.context: Occurs when a math task specifies a rank, order, or extremal ranking; usually co-occurs with calculation or sorting instructions.
patterns.domain: Differentiation, sorting, and comparison problems from DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Minus signs and negative-number operations
patterns.context: A minus sign is adjacent to a number or algebraic term, appearing in base conversion, division, polynomials, and sorting tasks; activation may overlap with instruction patterns.
patterns.domain: Arithmetic and algebra problems from DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and expression fragments
patterns.context: Operators, variables, and powers occur in formulas or calculation expressions; often adjacent to natural-language problems, but sometimes the expression itself is long.
patterns.domain: Symbolic calculation problems from DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Numbers and numerical strings
patterns.context: Dense digit strings occur in problem statements, input values, or near answers; also appear in expressions and sorting data.

patterns.name: Numbers/ordinal fragments in citation markers
patterns.context: Numbers are embedded in bracketed references or arXiv identifiers rather than mathematical instructions; observed only in this passage.

patterns.name: Inequalities and geometric terminology in mathematical papers
patterns.context: The body of a mathematical discussion presents conditions and conclusions, including inequalities and citations; it does not have the instruction style of an exercise.

patterns.name: Measurement values in spectroscopy papers
patterns.context: Values and units occur in descriptions of CO vibrational-band detection and absorption spectra.

0_2490.description: 主要响应数学练习题中的指令与排序、求导等表达，也伴随数字串、负号和运算符；少数激活落在论文引文编号、不等式论述及光谱数值中，未见能统一解释全部片段的单一触发词。

patterns.name: 数学题指令用语
patterns.trigger: "Calculate"、"What is"、"Find"、"Convert"、"Sort"、"in ascending order"、"in decreasing order"、"smallest value"、"second biggest"
patterns.context: 触发于数学问题的自然语言指令或问句，尤其是要求计算、转换、排序或求导的句子；多在任务开头或结尾。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的算术、代数练习题

patterns.name: 序数与排名表达
patterns.trigger: "third derivative"、"second biggest"、"smallest value"、"in decreasing order"、"in ascending order"
patterns.context: 数学任务指定次序、阶数或极值排名时；通常与计算或排序指令同现。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的求导、排序与比较题

patterns.name: 负号及负数运算
patterns.context: 负号紧邻数字或代数项，出现在进制转换、除法、多项式及排序任务中；激活可能与指令模式交叠。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的算术与代数题

patterns.name: 数学符号与表达式片段
patterns.context: 公式或计算表达式中出现运算符、变量及幂；经常邻接自然语言题目，但也有长表达式本身。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的符号计算题

patterns.name: 数字与数值串
patterns.context: 密集数字串出现在计算题的题干、输入数值或答案附近；也见于表达式和排序数据。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的数值运算材料

patterns.name: 引文标识中的数字/序号片段
patterns.context: 数字嵌在方括号文献引用或 arXiv 编号中，而非数学指令；仅此段可见。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文的参考文献引用

patterns.name: 数学论文中的不等式与几何术语
patterns.context: 数学论述正文中讨论条件与结论，含不等式及引文；不呈现练习题式指令。

patterns.name: 光谱论文中的测量数值
patterns.context: 数值和单位出现在 CO 振动带的检测及吸收谱描述中。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 科学论文，光谱/物理化学

en.concept: Mathematical symbols and formal scientific text
en.description: Activation spans two clearly distinct kinds of text: terminology, conditions, and inequalities in ArXiv scientific papers; and numbers, operators, and problem instructions in math exercises involving algebra, bases, differentiation, division, comparison, and sorting. No single shared trigger word is apparent.

patterns.name: CO spectroscopy and astrophysical measurements
patterns.context: Describes CO absorption in water ice, polar/nonpolar band profiles, and vibrational-band positions.

patterns.name: Topological-insulator surface states and ARPES
patterns.context: Mentions spin-resolved ARPES measurements of topological-insulator surface states and references.

patterns.name: Geometrically finite groups and strict inequalities
patterns.context: A mathematical paper states a strict inequality under a geometrical-finiteness condition and cites a theorem result.

patterns.name: Operators and numbers in algebraic expansion
patterns.context: Dense polynomial products or power expressions appear alongside the Expand instruction; activation falls on operators, coefficients, and numbers.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, symbolic algebra problems and answers

patterns.name: Base-conversion questions and answers
patterns.context: Asks for a number's representation in one base and requests conversion to another base.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, elementary number theory exercises

patterns.name: Polynomial differentiation problems
patterns.context: Asks for the third derivative of a given polynomial, whose expression contains variables, coefficients, and powers.

patterns.name: Integer division exercises
patterns.context: Calculates integer division in a question-and-answer or exercise format, often with the answer on a new line.

patterns.name: Multiple-choice sorting and comparison
patterns.context: Provides letter-labeled numerical options and asks for the minimum or second-largest number.

patterns.name: Ascending or descending integer order
patterns.context: Asks to reorder a list of integers in ascending or descending order, with the answer on a separate line.

0_2490.concept: 数学符号与形式化科学文本
0_2490.description: 激活覆盖两类明显不同文本：ArXiv 科学论文中的术语、条件与不等式表述；以及数学练习中的数字、运算符和题目指令，涉及代数、进制、求导、除法、比较与排序。未见单一共同触发词。

patterns.name: CO 光谱与天体物理测量
patterns.trigger: « water»、« polar»、« ap»、«olar»、« fundamental»、« vibrational»、« band»、« at»
patterns.context: 描述水冰中 CO 的吸收、极性/非极性带型及振动带位置。
patterns.domain: ArXiv，天体物理或光谱学论文

patterns.name: 拓扑绝缘体表面态与 ARPES
patterns.context: 提及拓扑绝缘体表面态的自旋分辨 ARPES 测量及文献。

patterns.name: 几何有限群与严格不等式
patterns.context: 数学论文中陈述几何有限条件下成立的严格不等式，并引用定理结果。

patterns.name: 代数式展开中的运算符和数字
patterns.context: 密集的多项式乘积或幂表达式，伴随 Expand 指令；激活落在运算符、系数和数字上。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics，符号代数题目及答案

patterns.name: 进制转换问答
patterns.context: 询问某数在一种进制中的表示，并要求转换到另一进制。

patterns.name: 多项式求导题
patterns.trigger: « Find»、« third»、« derivative»、« of»、« wrt»，以及变量与幂次
patterns.context: 要求对给定多项式求三阶导数，表达式中有变量、系数和幂。

patterns.name: 整数除法练习
patterns.context: 以问答或练习形式计算整数相除，常带换行的答案。

patterns.name: 选择题式排序比较
patterns.trigger: « smallest»、« value»、«(»、«)»及字母选项；另有 « biggest»
patterns.context: 给出带字母标记的数值选项，询问最小值或第二大的数。

patterns.name: 整数升序或降序排列
patterns.trigger: « in»、« decreasing»、« order»、« Sort»、« ascending»，以及逗号分隔的正负整数
patterns.context: 要求将一列整数按升序或降序重排，答案另起一行。

en.concept: Bulgarian word endings and miscellaneous fragments
en.description: Most activations occur on the Bulgarian endings “ане/то”, commonly in nominalizations or verb forms. Other isolated activations occur on the Russian “Заранее”, an initial letter in a template word, and mathematical number fragments, with no unified explanation.

patterns.name: Bulgarian verb ending “ане”
patterns.context: Appears near the endings of Bulgarian nouns or gerunds, typically forming names of actions, processes, or states; sometimes marks a span across subword fragments.
patterns.domain: Bulgarian European Parliament text; also seen in Russian Q&A

patterns.name: Bulgarian inflectional ending “то”
patterns.context: Appears at the end of Bulgarian verb forms, forming neuter singular forms; examples relate to “постигането” and “гласуването”.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of Russian “заранее”
patterns.context: In a Russian StackExchange sentence, the complete word “Заранее” is marked across multiple subword fragments, suggesting the word itself rather than only the “ане” ending.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in a Russian technical word
patterns.context: Activation falls on the initial letters of the Russian technical word “шаблона”; the surrounding text discusses template length and the location found.

patterns.name: Number fragments in numerical or mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments of digit sequences, decimal numbers, or numbers in multiplication problems; there is no apparent connection to the Bulgarian morphology pattern.

0_2490.concept: 保加利亚语词尾及杂项片段
0_2490.description: 多数激活位于保加利亚语的「ане/то」词尾，常见于名词化过程或动词形式；另有俄语「Заранее」、模板词首字母及数学数字片段的孤立激活，未能统一解释。

patterns.name: 保加利亚语动词词尾「ане」
patterns.context: 出现在保加利亚语名词或动名词的词尾附近，通常构成行动、过程或状态名称；有时标记跨越子词片段。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会保加利亚语文本；另见俄语问答

patterns.name: 保加利亚语屈折词尾「то」
patterns.context: 出现在保加利亚语动词形式的词尾，构成中性单数形式；例中分别与「постигането」「гласуването」有关。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会保加利亚语文本

patterns.name: 俄语「заранее」词内片段
patterns.context: StackExchange 俄语句子中完整词「Заранее」被拆成多个子词片段标记，疑似针对该词，而非仅针对「ане」词尾。

patterns.name: 俄语技术词中的内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在俄语技术词「шаблона」的词首字母，周围讨论模板长度与找到的位置。

patterns.name: 数字或数学表达中的数字片段
patterns.context: 激活落在数字序列、十进制数或乘积题目中的数字片段；与保加利亚语形态模式没有明显联系。

en.description: The most consistent trigger is the hyphen “.-”: it occurs both in author-name initials and in PACS classification codes. Other activations occur at quotation boundaries in author names, abbreviation letters, and a few punctuation marks, numbers, and word fragments.

patterns.name: Author-name initials before a hyphen
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated in initials in names, especially period-hyphen combinations between first or middle initials; the surrounding text is typically an author list.

patterns.name: Hyphens in PACS/subject classification codes
patterns.context: Occurs after the decimal point in a numeric classification code and before a letter classification symbol; passages usually contain PACS numbers or similar subject classification codes.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper metadata and physics classification

patterns.name: Apostrophes and quotation boundaries in author lists
patterns.context: An apostrophe occurs immediately after the end of an author name, often in an author entry enclosed in quotation marks; the activation is weaker but recurs.

patterns.name: Initials and name fragments in author lists
patterns.context: Appears in initials, spelling fragments of names, and author lists; not always accompanied by a hyphen, and the exact activation location varies.

patterns.name: Comma punctuation
patterns.context: Occurs after commas in titles, abstract-like text, and PACS code lists; activation is weak, with no consistent semantic context.
patterns.domain: Punctuation in paper metadata and technical text

patterns.name: Specific number fragments
patterns.context: Occasionally occurs in figure scales, citation page numbers, or classification codes, with no stable shared context.
patterns.domain: Numbers and identifiers in scientific papers

patterns.name: Rare letters or word-ending fragments
patterns.context: Sporadically occurs in body-text words or classification codes, without a consistent local trigger.
patterns.domain: Scientific paper body text and metadata

0_2490.concept: 点号连字符及元数据格式
0_2490.description: 最稳定触发是连字符“.-”：既见于作者姓名缩写，也见于PACS分类码；此外有作者姓名引号边界、缩写字母和少量标点、数字及词片段激活。

patterns.name: 连字符前的作者名缩写
patterns.context: 激活集中出现在姓名缩写中，尤其是名字或中间名缩写之间的句点连字符组合；周围通常是作者列表。

patterns.name: PACS/学科分类代码中的连字符
patterns.context: 出现在数字分类代码的小数点之后、字母分类符之前；段落通常包含PACS号码或类似学科分类代码。
patterns.domain: ArXiv论文元数据与物理学分类

patterns.name: 作者列表中的撇号与引号边界
patterns.context: 作者姓名末尾紧邻撇号，常见于以引号包围的作者条目；虽非最强激活，但反复出现。

patterns.name: 作者列表中的字母缩写与姓名片段
patterns.trigger: «H»5、«S»2、«R»1、«D»1等被标记的单字母或姓名片段
patterns.context: 出现在姓名缩写、姓名拼写片段及作者列表中；不总伴随连字符，具体激活位置不一。

patterns.name: 逗号标点
patterns.context: 出现在标题、摘要式文本及PACS代码列表的逗号后；激活较弱，语义上下文不统一。
patterns.domain: 论文元数据及科技文本标点

patterns.name: 特定数字片段
patterns.context: 偶见于图示刻度、引文页码或分类代码，未见稳定共同语境。
patterns.domain: 科技论文中的数字与编号

patterns.name: 稀有字母或词尾片段
patterns.context: 零散出现在正文词语或分类代码中，缺乏一致的局部触发条件。
patterns.domain: 科技论文正文与元数据

en.description: All ten passages activate on the same letter substring sam. It occurs in different words, including samizdat, samplers, sammanhållningen, samtyckt, samarbete, samtid, samråder, and samen, across languages, domains, and styles, with no consistent semantic or grammatical condition.

patterns.name: sam subword fragment
patterns.context: The highlighted span is the consecutive letters sam inside a word; it need not be a complete word. In English examples, the following letters form different words.
patterns.domain: Multilingual text, including ArXiv and European Parliament text

0_2490.description: 全部十段都激活同一字母子串 sam；它出现在 samizdat、samplers、sammanhållningen、samtyckt、samarbete、samtid、samråder、samen 等不同词中，跨语言、领域和文体，未见一致的语义或语法条件。

patterns.name: sam 子词片段
patterns.context: 高亮的是单词内部连续字母 sam，并不要求它是完整词；在英语实例中，后续字母组成不同词语。
patterns.domain: 多语种文本，含 ArXiv 与欧洲议会文本

en.description: The most prominent common clue is the ku substring inside words across languages, but the specific words and contexts vary. In two passages, there is also a strong response to the homogen stem, referring respectively to homogenization processes and cultural homogenization. Other markers are scattered and have no unified explanation.

patterns.name: ku substring
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the ku substring; it occurs in different words, often internally rather than as a standalone word.
patterns.domain: Math problems, Estonian and Finnish parliamentary text, Spanish chat, Polish text

patterns.name: homogen stem
patterns.context: Occurs in a past participle describing the homogenization of a mixture and in a noun referring to cultural homogenization.

patterns.name: Other sporadic markers
patterns.context: These markers are scattered across passages; no sufficiently consistent local semantic or syntactic condition is apparent, making them difficult to group with the ku or homogen patterns.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, parliamentary records, chat, religious texts, scientific papers, cultural commentary

0_2490.concept: 词片段 ku 与 homogen
0_2490.description: 最突出的共同线索是跨语言词内的 ku 子串，但具体词和语境多变；另在两段中强烈响应 homogen 词干，分别指均质化过程与文化同质化。其余标记分散，尚无统一解释。

patterns.name: ku 子串
patterns.context: 激活集中在 ku 子串；在不同词语中出现，往往是词内部而非独立词。
patterns.domain: 数学题、爱沙尼亚语和芬兰语议会文本、西班牙语聊天、波兰语文本

patterns.name: homogen 词干
patterns.context: 出现在描述混合物均质化的过去分词，以及谈论文化同质化的名词中。

patterns.name: 其他零散标记
patterns.trigger: «bv»、«dir»、«aaa»、«ak»、«akk»、«prob»、« Euro»、«opa»、« k»、« Haiti»、« e»、«else»、« Bar»、« bu»、«G»、«!»、«P»、«Ja»、« %»、« wave»、« worldwide»、« local»
patterns.context: 这些标记分散在各段；未见足够一致的局部语义或句法条件，难以归入 ku 或 homogen 模式。
patterns.domain: 数学、议会记录、聊天、宗教文本、科学论文、文化评论

en.description: This neuron responds strongly to the homogen stem and its derivatives: most passages concern biological sample homogenization, homogenizers, or homogenates; another passage refers to cultural homogenization caused by commercial civilization.

patterns.name: “homogen” stem: samples are homogenized
patterns.context: Appears in methods descriptions referring to homogenizing samples, tissues, or cells, or mentioning homogenizers or homogenates; often near words such as buffer, tissue, cell, or organ

patterns.name: “homogenization” stem: sociocultural homogenization
patterns.context: Discusses the disappearance of local and regional cultural differences due to the expansion of commercial civilization; activation falls on the homogenization stem
patterns.domain: Sociocultural criticism / architecture and urban theory

0_2490.description: 该神经元强烈响应 homogen 词干及其派生词：多数段落指生物样本均质化、匀浆器或匀浆物；另有一段指商业文明导致的文化同质化。

patterns.name: “homogen”词干：样品被均质化
patterns.context: 出现于方法描述中，指对样品、组织或细胞进行均质化处理，或提及均质器、匀浆物；周围常有缓冲液、组织、细胞或器官等词

patterns.name: “homogenization”词干：社会文化同质化
patterns.context: 谈论商业文明扩张造成地方与区域文化差异消失；激活落在 homogenization 词干上
patterns.domain: 社会文化批评／建筑与城市理论

en.description: All passages contain and activate the homogen stem; most concern experimental homogenization and its products, while a few concern cultural homogenization. One passage also activates ultrapure, local, and regional, corresponding respectively to laboratory water and local-culture contexts.

patterns.name: homogenize forms in scientific text
patterns.context: Activation falls on the subword fragment of the English words homogenize/homogenized/homogenizer/homogenate; usually describes homogenizing samples, tissues, cells, or cultures, and occasionally abstract homogenization.
patterns.domain: Research papers; primarily biomedical experimental methods, with some sociocultural commentary

patterns.name: Subword fragment within ultrapure
patterns.context: Appears before “water from Fluka Chemie AG,” describing laboratory water; homogenized appears later in the same passage.

patterns.name: Local and regional cultural references
patterns.context: Appears near words such as distinctive and cultures, discussing global commercial civilization overshadowing local cultures and their homogenization; not an experimental context.

0_2490.description: 所有段都含 homogen 词干并触发；主要是实验中均质处理及其产物，少数是文化同质化。另有一段同时触发 ultrapure、local、regional，分别对应实验用水与地方文化语境。

patterns.name: 科学文本中的 homogenize 词形
patterns.context: 激活落在英语词 homogenize/homogenized/homogenizer/homogenate 的词干片段；通常描述样品、组织、细胞或培养物的均质处理，偶尔是抽象的同质化。
patterns.domain: 科研论文；以生物医学实验方法为主，另有社会文化评论

patterns.name: ultrapure 的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在“water from Fluka Chemie AG”之前，描述实验用水；同段稍后出现 homogenized。

patterns.name: 局部与区域文化表述
patterns.context: 与 distinctive、cultures 等词相邻，讨论全球商业文明压过地方文化及其同质化；不属于实验操作语境。

en.description: All passages contain the split root in forms including split, splitters, and splitting. Strong activation occurs whether it refers to separation, division, a mathematical property, or an equipment term.

patterns.name: split and its inflected forms
patterns.context: The split root appears in multiple forms, including verbs, compounds, and nominalizations, without requiring a specific field or fixed syntactic position.

patterns.name: split in compound terms
patterns.context: split appears as a technical term or part of a compound, with meanings that vary by context: separation, division, an algebraic structure property, or an equipment name.
patterns.domain: Quantum gravity, optimization, quantum mechanics, mathematics, physics, optics, computer science

0_2490.description: 所有片段都含有 split 词根，形式包括 split、splitters、splitting；无论它表示分离、划分、数学性质还是设备术语，均出现强激活。

0_2596.concept: 代码模板中的结构边界符

patterns.name: 格式化占位符与右花括号

patterns.name: 路由模板中的参数花括号

patterns.name: 匿名对象与代码块的闭合花括号

patterns.name: 代码字符串内的双引号和引号边界

patterns.name: 冒号引出的格式说明或键值分隔
patterns.trigger: 「:」，包括「{0:10000.000}」「"{0:dd/MM/yyyy}"」以及对象、配置中的键值冒号
patterns.context: 格式占位符的冒号后接格式模式，或代码/JSON 中分隔属性名和值；具体语义随语境变化

patterns.name: 日期格式中的斜线分隔符
patterns.context: 出现在日期显示格式字符串中，表示日、月、年之间的分隔
patterns.domain: ASP.NET 数据注解与日期格式代码

patterns.name: 正则命名捕获组边界
patterns.context: 正则表达式中的命名捕获组，后续通过 Groups 索引访问
patterns.domain: C# 正则表达式编程问答

patterns.name: 数字格式化与数值标点

patterns.name: Brace parameters in route templates

patterns.name: 路由模板中的花括号参数

patterns.name: JSON 字段和值附近的结构标记

en.description: All passages activate on teenagers or an immediately adjacent token; the word appears in varied domains and syntactic contexts, covering teenage identity, groups, age statistics, and relations with adults.

patterns.name: Teenage age group
patterns.context: The word teenagers appears in sentences describing or referring to teenage groups; includes parental age context, drug victims, subjects in discussions of adulthood, chat partners, news audiences, book readers, community center users, demographic categories, and story characters or one side of generational conflict.
patterns.domain: Various genres including legal texts, forums, news, project descriptions, tables, demographics, literature, and social issues

patterns.name: Adjacent word-form token
patterns.context: The activation marker falls on the preceding token adjacent to teenagers, rather than on teenagers itself; the contexts are patient age descriptions and population age groupings, respectively.

0_2596.description: 所有片段都围绕 teenagers（青少年）或其紧邻 token 激活；该词出现在多种领域和句法语境中，涵盖青少年身份、群体、年龄统计及其与成人的关系。

patterns.name: 青少年年龄群体
patterns.context: 词语 teenagers 出现在描述或指称青少年群体的句子中；包括作为家长的年龄背景、药物受害者、成年期讨论对象、聊天对象、新闻受众、书籍读者、社区中心使用者、人口统计类别，以及故事角色或代际冲突一方。
patterns.domain: 法律、论坛、新闻、项目说明、表格、人口统计、文学与社会议题等多种文体

patterns.name: 相邻词形 token
patterns.trigger: [2] 中 «teenagers» 前的 «as»10；[8] 中 «teenagers» 前的 «70»10
patterns.context: 激活标记落在与 teenagers 相邻的前一 token，而非 teenagers 本身；语境仍分别是患者年龄描述和人口年龄分组。

en.description: Strong activations center on two distinct terms: Pale (including forms such as Paleozoic) and discriminate. Other markers are sporadic across domains and lack a unified trigger pattern.

patterns.name: The word “Pale”
patterns.context: Appears in names, proper nouns, or compounds, with inconsistent surrounding context, such as “English Pale,” “Seven Shades of Pale,” “Pale Green,” “the Pale Stranger,” and “Paleozoic.”

patterns.name: The word “discriminate”
patterns.context: Appears in sentences discussing distinguishing different signals or models, or discrimination in law and policy.
patterns.domain: Physics papers, cosmology papers, parliamentary records, court decisions

patterns.name: Other sporadic terms
patterns.context: Each occurs in a different context, with no shared local semantic or syntactic condition; activations may correspond to other word forms, subword fragments, or contextual features.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, Q&A, medical abstracts, scientific papers

patterns.name: Sporadic function words and short fragments
patterns.context: Distributed across various syntactic environments, with no consistent trigger condition; activation strength is also lower than for the primary trigger words.

0_2596.description: 强激活集中在两个互不相同的词项：Pale（含Paleozoic等词形）与discriminate。其他标记零散分布于多领域语境，缺乏可统一的触发模式。

patterns.name: “Pale”一词
patterns.context: 在名称、专名或复合词中出现，前后文并不统一：如“English Pale”“Seven Shades of Pale”“Pale Green”“the Pale Stranger”“Paleozoic”。

patterns.name: “discriminate”一词
patterns.context: 出现在讨论区分不同信号或模型，或法律、政策中的歧视行为的句子里。
patterns.domain: 物理学论文、宇宙学论文、议会记录、法律判决

patterns.name: 其他零散词项
patterns.context: 各自出现在不同语境中，未见共同的局部语义或句法条件；激活可能对应其他词形、分词片段或上下文特征。
patterns.domain: 百科、问答、医学摘要、科学论文

patterns.name: 零散功能词及短片段
patterns.context: 分布于多种句法环境，未显示一致的触发条件；强度也低于主要触发词。

en.description: All passages contain the strongly activating token «Milan»; it refers to the Italian city or appears in proper names such as personal names, teams, institutions, and record labels. The trigger does not depend on a single domain or genre.

patterns.name: Place name Milan
patterns.context: Milan appears in dates, locations, and judge signatures in court opinions; as a conference location in academic papers; in ethics approval bodies for medical research; and in location details in sports or biographies. It is sometimes followed by Italy or an affiliated institution

0_2596.description: 所有片段均包含强激活 token «Milan»；它指意大利城市米兰，或出现在人名、球队、机构、唱片品牌等专名中。触发不依赖单一领域或文体。

patterns.name: 米兰地名
patterns.trigger: «Milan»10，常与« California»3、« Italy»7 等地名相邻
patterns.context: 在法院意见的日期、地点和法官署名中，学术论文的会议地点、医学研究伦理审批机构、体育或人物传记中的地点信息里出现 Milan；有时后接 Italy 或所属机构
patterns.domain: 法律、学术、医学、体育、百科

en.description: The most stable trigger is the state name “Kentucky,” spanning law, history, lists, prose, and bibliographies; local co-occurring triggers also include legal terms and citation words, state lists, and historical polity terms.

patterns.name: State name Kentucky
patterns.context: The state name occurs in legal citations, party addresses or case facts; it also appears in historical narratives, state lists, reminiscences, and book titles.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, historical texts, general prose, catalogs

patterns.name: Batson in legal citations
patterns.context: Paired with “v. Kentucky” as a case name; appears in legal contexts discussing motions for a new trial or appeals of convictions.

patterns.name: Trial vocabulary in legal contexts
patterns.context: Appears in judicial procedure expressions such as “new trial” and “trial court.”

patterns.name: Federal court terminology in legal citations
patterns.context: Appears as part of a federal appellate court name.

patterns.name: Judgment and litigation terminology
patterns.context: Refers to a guilty plea or plea bargain in a criminal case, with nearby references to a lesser charge and the Padilla case.

patterns.name: Names of legal parties
patterns.context: Appears near the names and signature details of attorneys or judges at the beginning of an appellate decision.

patterns.name: Historical state admission to the Union
patterns.context: Lists states joining a political entity and the dates; Kentucky appears in the same historical narrative.

patterns.name: Place name in a state list
patterns.context: Kentucky is one item in a list of donation source locations organized by state.

patterns.name: Kentucky reminiscences
patterns.context: The setting of towns, a doctor, and childhood life in a first-person reminiscence.

patterns.name: Kentucky in bibliographic titles
patterns.context: Appears as part of a book title or subtitle in a numbered catalog entry.

0_2596.description: 最稳定的触发是州名“Kentucky”，涵盖法律、历史、清单、散文与书目；另有法律术语及引证词、州名清单和历史政体词等局部共现触发。

patterns.name: Kentucky 州名
patterns.context: 州名出现在法律案件的引证、当事人地址或案情中；也出现在历史叙述、州名列表、回忆文字和书名中。

patterns.name: 法律引证中的 Batson

patterns.name: 法律语境中的审判词汇
patterns.context: 出现在“new trial”及“trial court”等司法程序表达中。

patterns.name: 法律引证中的联邦法院术语
patterns.context: 作为联邦上诉法院名称的一部分出现。

patterns.name: 判决、诉讼术语
patterns.context: 在刑事案件中指认罪答辩或认罪协商，附近提及较轻罪名及 Padilla 案。

patterns.name: 法律当事人姓名
patterns.context: 出现在上诉判决开头的律师或法官姓名、署名信息附近。

patterns.name: 历史上的州加入联邦
patterns.context: 列举州加入某政治实体及日期；与 Kentucky 同处历史叙述。

patterns.name: 州名清单中的地名
patterns.context: 在按州列出的捐款来源地名清单中，Kentucky 是其中一项。

patterns.name: 肯塔基回忆叙述
patterns.context: 第一人称回忆中的城镇、医生和童年生活背景。

patterns.name: 书目标题中的 Kentucky
patterns.context: 作为书名副标题或标题的一部分，出现在编号目录条目中。

en.description: All passages contain and strongly mark Kentucky; it can activate in legal cases and addresses, historical narratives, state lists, prose, and bibliographies. Other state names in lists are also weakly marked.

patterns.name: State name Kentucky
patterns.context: The state name Kentucky appears in body text, citations, case names, author or institution addresses, historical narratives, and bibliographic titles; its contextual function varies, but the word itself is consistent.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, historical texts, narrative prose, bibliographic lists

patterns.name: Enumeration of U.S. states
patterns.context: A state name appears as an item in a list of U.S. states; the list also includes strongly activating Kentucky.
patterns.domain: Fundraising announcements or organizational information lists

patterns.name: State name in the same case citation
patterns.context: Appears in case names such as “Batson v. Kentucky” or “Padilla v. Kentucky” as part of a legal citation.

0_2596.description: 所有片段都出现并强烈标记 Kentucky；它在法律判例与地址、历史叙述、州名列表、散文和书目中均可触发。其他州名在列表中也有较弱标记。

patterns.name: 肯塔基州名
patterns.context: 在正文、引文、判例名称、作者或机构地址、历史叙述、书目标题中出现州名 Kentucky；上下文功能多样，均为该词本身。

patterns.name: 美国州名枚举
patterns.context: 州名作为美国各州名单中的项目出现；同时包含强激活的 Kentucky。
patterns.domain: 募捐公告或组织信息列表

patterns.name: 同一判例引证中的州名
patterns.context: 出现在“Batson v. Kentucky”或“Padilla v. Kentucky”这类判例名称中，作为法律引证的一部分。
patterns.domain: 美国上诉法院法律文书

en.concept: Information about Switzerland and related locations

patterns.name: Swiss cities and institutional addresses

patterns.name: Swiss institution or manufacturer names

patterns.name: Switzerland as a research location

patterns.name: Biographical residence

patterns.name: Hard-to-classify local lexical activation

0_2596.concept: 瑞士及其相关地点信息

patterns.name: 瑞士作为设备来源地

patterns.name: 出版商版权行

patterns.name: 书籍图版与红十字会说明

patterns.name: 人物居住地简介

patterns.name: 难以归类的局部词汇激活

en.description: The most consistent trigger is the complete word Sacramento, covering the California city and county, ecological species, courts and addresses, and sports teams, as well as a historical Portuguese place name. Other sporadic subword fragments lack a consistent pattern.

patterns.name: The place name Sacramento
patterns.context: Activation centers on the place name Sacramento. It appears in court jurisdictions, city addresses, physical geography, species names, sports team names, historical place names, institutional addresses, and personal accounts. Various collocations and genres can trigger it.
patterns.domain: Law, natural sciences, encyclopedias, sports, history, email, and personal blogs

patterns.name: Place names and jurisdiction in legal documents
patterns.context: Sacramento occurs alongside County, courts, prosecutors, or litigant information, serving as the trial venue or office location.

patterns.name: Ecology and species of the Sacramento region
patterns.context: Sacramento modifies a county or fish name, or appears in lists of California rivers, wetlands, and wildlife species.
patterns.domain: Entomology, freshwater ecology, conservation, and encyclopedic sources

patterns.name: Sacramento as a city address or personal itinerary location
patterns.context: Sacramento serves as a geographical location in references to residence, work, correspondence, travel, or personal accounts, often with a state name, postal information, or specific activity.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, business emails, personal blogs

patterns.name: Historical place name Colônia do Sacramento
patterns.context: Sacramento is part of a Portuguese proper noun in a historical account of the Spanish invasion and refugee migration; it does not refer to the California city.

patterns.name: Sacramento Kings team name
patterns.context: Sacramento appears with Kings, referring to the professional basketball team and player-trade context.

patterns.name: Other notable activation fragments
patterns.context: These markers are scattered across names, common words, proper nouns, sentence beginnings, and subword fragments. Apart from co-occurrence in passages with Sacramento, no stable shared trigger is evident; they may be secondary or incidental activations.
patterns.domain: Mixed corpora including law, science, encyclopedias, email, and blogs

0_2596.description: 最稳定的触发是完整词 Sacramento，涵盖加州城市及县、生态物种、法院与地址、球队，也包括葡萄牙历史地名；其余零散词片段缺乏一致模式。

patterns.name: Sacramento 作为城市地址或个人行程地点

patterns.context: Sacramento 用作居住、工作、通信、旅行或个人叙述中的地理地点，常伴州名、邮政信息或具体活动。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、商务邮件、个人博客

patterns.name: 历史地名 Colônia do Sacramento
patterns.context: Sacramento 是葡语专名的一部分，处于西班牙入侵及难民迁移的历史叙述中，并非加州城市。

patterns.name: Sacramento Kings 球队名
patterns.context: Sacramento 与 Kings 连用，指职业篮球队及球员交易背景。

patterns.name: 其他显著激活片段
patterns.context: 这些标记分散在姓名、普通词、专名、句首或子词片段中；除与 Sacramento 同段共现外，未显示稳定的共同触发条件，可能是次级或偶发激活。
patterns.domain: 法律、科学、百科、邮件及博客等混合语料

en.description: All passages strongly mark “Belgium,” covering addresses, research locations, people’s activity locations, and organizational locations. A few mathematical terms are also marked, possibly as secondary patterns from nearby context.

patterns.name: Belgium as an address or institutional location
patterns.context: The country name appears in an address, institutional location, or author contact information, usually introduced by a city or institution name.
patterns.domain: Paper author addresses and institutional information

patterns.name: Belgium as a research location or the location of a study population
patterns.context: The country name marks the region where study samples, cases, strains, or social media activity are located.
patterns.domain: Medical and life sciences papers; social media accounts

patterns.name: Belgium as a location where people are active
patterns.context: The country name appears in accounts of people’s experiences or activity locations.

patterns.name: Belgium as an organization’s office location
patterns.context: The country name appears with the capital to specify an organization’s administrative office location.

patterns.name: Activation near mathematical terms or formulas
patterns.context: Occurs near the title and author affiliation in a mathematics paper; these terms are also marked but differ from the country-name pattern that triggers the other passages.

0_2596.description: 所有段均强烈标记“Belgium”，涵盖地址、研究地点、人物活动地及组织所在地；少数数学词也被标记，可能是邻近上下文的次级模式。

patterns.name: Belgium作为地址/单位所在地
patterns.trigger: «Belgium»10；周围常见城市、街道、机构地址，如“Gent, Belgium”“Mariakerke, Belgium”“Liège, Belgium”
patterns.context: 国家名出现在地址、机构所在地或作者联系信息中；通常由城市或机构名称引出
patterns.domain: 论文作者地址、机构信息

patterns.name: Belgium作为研究地点或研究对象所在地
patterns.trigger: «Belgium»10；如“in Belgium”“in the Flemish part of Belgium”
patterns.context: 国家名标记研究样本、病例、菌株或社交媒体活动所在地区
patterns.domain: 医学与生命科学论文、社交媒体叙述

patterns.name: Belgium作为人物活动地点
patterns.context: 国家名出现在人物经历或活动地点的叙述中

patterns.name: Belgium作为组织办公地点
patterns.context: 国家名与首都连用，说明组织行政办公室所在地

patterns.name: 数学术语或公式邻近激活
patterns.context: 数学论文标题与作者单位附近；这些词本身也被标记，但与其他段落共同触发的国家名模式不同

en.concept: Recognition of the place name Belgium
en.description: The core response is the country name Belgium, especially in location, address, or institutional-location contexts; Brussels co-occurs with it. Other weaker activations are scattered across fields and lack a unified pattern.

patterns.name: Country name Belgium
patterns.context: The country name Belgium appears in an address, institutional location, study population, or location description; this trigger occurs in every passage.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including academic papers, personal profiles, social media, and encyclopedias

patterns.name: Related location Brussels
patterns.context: The city name Brussels appears with Belgium as the location of an office.

patterns.name: Sporadic accompanying activations
patterns.context: These words appear only in individual passages and belong to different topics, with no stable shared condition; their activation is weaker than Belgium.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, social media, medicine, biology, music, and other fields

0_2596.description: 核心反应是国家名 Belgium，尤其出现在地点、地址或机构所在地语境；Brussels 与之共现。其余较弱激活分散于各领域，缺少统一模式。

patterns.name: 国家名 Belgium
patterns.context: 在地址、机构所在地、研究对象或叙述地点中出现国家名 Belgium；各段均有该触发词
patterns.domain: 学术论文、个人资料、社交媒体、百科等多种文体

patterns.name: 相关地点 Brussels
patterns.context: 城市名 Brussels 与国家名 Belgium 连用，作为办公室所在地

patterns.name: 零散伴随激活
patterns.trigger: « Mathematics»3、« Facebook»3/5、« ROC»2、« porcine»2、« leukemia»3、« Western»2 等
patterns.context: 这些词只在个别段落出现，分属不同主题，未见稳定共同条件；相较 Belgium 激活较弱
patterns.domain: 数学、社交媒体、医学、生物学、音乐等

en.description: Every snippet contains «Bulgaria» in English, and this token is the strongest activation in each case. The preceding text may be a list of neighboring countries, a place description, or an unrelated account; topics and genres vary.

patterns.name: Country name Bulgaria
patterns.context: The country name Bulgaria appears in English text, usually in a place name or a list of countries, but it can also appear at the end of a sentence.
patterns.domain: English texts from many fields, including academic papers, encyclopedias, and websites

patterns.name: Bulgarian place names and proper nouns
patterns.context: Describes Bulgarian cities, regions, villages, history, or institutions; the core activation remains the country name rather than a specific fixed collocation.

patterns.name: Bulgaria in lists of European countries
patterns.context: Appears as an item in a list of countries or regions.

patterns.name: Bulgaria in other contexts
patterns.context: The country name appears in music news, travel chats, or petition text without requiring a geographical description or a neighboring country list.
patterns.domain: News, informal online communication, and advocacy text

0_2596.description: 所有片段都在英文语境中出现 «Bulgaria»，且该 token 均为最强激活；前文可为邻国名单、地名介绍或无关叙述，题材和文体多样。

patterns.name: 国家名 Bulgaria
patterns.context: 在英文文本中出现国家名 Bulgaria；通常位于地名或并列国家名单中，也可出现在句尾。
patterns.domain: 多领域英文文本：学术论文、百科、网页等

patterns.name: 保加利亚地名与专名
patterns.context: 描述保加利亚的城市、地区、村庄、历史或机构；激活核心仍是国家名，并非只针对某个固定搭配。

patterns.name: 欧洲国家并列名单中的 Bulgaria
patterns.context: 在罗列国家或地区时作为名单成员出现。
patterns.domain: 学术论文与出版宣传文案

patterns.name: 其他语境中的 Bulgaria
patterns.context: 国家名出现于音乐新闻、旅行聊天或请愿文本，并不要求地理介绍或相邻国家名单。
patterns.domain: 新闻、非正式网页交流、倡议文本

en.description: All snippets reach their strongest activation at the country name «Austria», covering academic addresses, general location references, and historical and political accounts; Vienna often co-occurs. A few other marked words lack consistency across passages.

patterns.name: Country name in an institutional address
patterns.context: The country field in a university, research institution, or author affiliation address; sometimes preceded by a street, postal code, or institution name.
patterns.domain: Academic paper author addresses, publication information, and paper methods sections

patterns.name: Austria in general geographical or everyday accounts
patterns.context: Mentioned as a place or country; it may be associated with local transport, shops, or conservation permits, without requiring an address format.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions and nature conservation or collecting notes

patterns.name: Austria in historical and political accounts
patterns.context: The country or its residents appear as subjects of historical, diplomatic, political, or biographical accounts.

0_2596.description: 所有片段都在国家名«Austria»处达到最强激活，涵盖学术地址、一般地点提及及历史政治叙述；Vienna常与之同现。少数其他标记词缺乏跨段稳定性。

patterns.name: 国家名出现在机构地址
patterns.context: 大学、研究机构或作者单位地址中，作为城市/国家地址的国家字段；有时前接街道、邮编或机构名称
patterns.domain: 学术论文作者地址、出版信息及论文方法部分

patterns.name: 一般地理或生活叙述中的奥地利
patterns.context: 作为地点或国家被提及；可能关联当地交通、商店或保护区许可，不要求地址格式
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、自然保护/采集说明

patterns.name: 历史政治叙述中的奥地利
patterns.context: 国家或其居民作为历史、外交、政治或人物传记叙述的对象出现
patterns.domain: 百科全书式历史与人物介绍

en.concept: Academic addresses and institutional proper nouns
en.description: Primarily responds to country names in author affiliations, especially France; it also responds to Paris and fragments such as Université and Institut in French institution names. A few activations occur on Germany, the United States, Tel Aviv, and other proper-name fragments.

patterns.name: France in French addresses
patterns.context: At the end of an institutional or author address, usually following a city, postal code, or region; this is the most consistent and strongest trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Place name Paris
patterns.context: Appears in French universities, research institutions, or addresses, often adjacent to Université, Sorbonne, Diderot, and similar terms; in [2], it is Paris 6.

patterns.name: French institutional vocabulary
patterns.context: Inside the names of French universities, research institutes, or laboratories; the triggered portion is sometimes only part of a word.

patterns.name: Germany in German addresses
patterns.context: At the end of an institutional entry with Germany as the country; it follows the same country-name trigger pattern as French addresses, but with a different country.

patterns.name: Other country or place-name fragments
patterns.context: Country or city names in address or institutional entries; each appears only once, so a more specific shared condition cannot be established.

patterns.name: Other institutional proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Partial word segments in institution or personal names, without enough repeated evidence to show that they are independent, stable trigger patterns.

0_2596.description: 主要响应作者单位地址中的国家名，尤其是法国；也响应巴黎及法国机构名称中的Université、Institut等片段。少数激活落在德国、美国、特拉维夫和其他专名片段上。

patterns.name: 法国地址中的 France
patterns.context: 机构或作者地址的末尾，通常跟在城市、邮编或地区之后；是最一致、最强的触发模式。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文作者单位与地址

patterns.name: 巴黎地名
patterns.context: 出现在法国高校、研究机构或地址中，常与 Université、Sorbonne、Diderot 等词相邻；[2] 中为 Paris 6。

patterns.name: 法国机构词汇
patterns.context: 法国大学、研究所或实验室名称内部；触发部分有时只是词的一段。

patterns.name: 德国地址中的 Germany
patterns.context: 地址以德国为国家的机构条目末尾；与法国地址模式同属国家名触发，但国家不同。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文作者单位与地址

patterns.name: 其他国家或地名片段
patterns.context: 地址或机构条目中的国家名、城市名；各自仅出现一次，无法确认是否有更具体的共同条件。

patterns.name: 其他机构专名片段
patterns.context: 机构名称或人名中的局部词段，缺少足够重复证据表明它们是独立、稳定的触发模式。

en.concept: Scotland and its British regional context
en.description: The most consistent trigger is the place name Scotland; the feature also responds to Scottish, British, and British Isles geographical terms. Other weaker triggers include lists of countries and regions, historical figures, titles, and monetary amounts, across a range of genres.

patterns.name: Place name Scotland
patterns.context: The place name Scotland appears in a sentence, often with in/of/to, or as part of the United Kingdom or a location modifier.
patterns.domain: British history, literature, news, public policy, sports, medicine, and encyclopedias

patterns.name: Adjective Scottish
patterns.context: The adjective Scottish modifies government.

patterns.name: Lists of British regional names
patterns.context: Appears alongside Scotland as a country or region name; activation is weaker than for Scotland.
patterns.domain: Country or regional comparisons and statistics

patterns.name: British-related modifiers
patterns.context: Modifies institutional or identity nouns such as Bishops and Sculptors.

patterns.name: British Isles geographical terms
patterns.context: Occurs near accounts of Scottish history or geography, involving cities, directions, islands, or the Highlands.
patterns.domain: History, geography, and healthcare service encyclopedias

patterns.name: Irish or Scottish historical figures
patterns.context: Appears in accounts of the arrival of early Christianity in Scotland and surrounding regions.

patterns.name: Scotland in a literary title
patterns.context: Scotland is embedded in a work title related to 1746 and a catalog of satirical poems.

patterns.name: Word forms related to Scottish place names
patterns.context: Scotland appears as the jurisdiction of a government or climate act.

patterns.name: British currency and per-capita spending comparisons
patterns.context: A currency symbol appears in a comparison of per-capita public spending in England, Wales, and Scotland.

patterns.name: Heterogeneous strong activation trigger
patterns.context: An amount follows the pound sign; the precise trigger boundary may include the currency symbol and following number.

0_2596.concept: 苏格兰及其英国地域语境
0_2596.description: 最稳定的触发是地名 Scotland；也响应 Scottish、British 及英伦地理词。其他强度较弱的触发包括并列国家地区名、历史人物、标题和财政金额，场景横跨多种文体。

patterns.name: 苏格兰地名
patterns.context: 地名 Scotland 出现在句中，常与介词 in/of/to 搭配，或作为英国构成部分、地点限定语
patterns.domain: 英国历史、文学、新闻、公共政策、体育、医疗、百科

patterns.name: 苏格兰形容词
patterns.context: 形容词 Scottish 修饰 government

patterns.name: 英国地域名称并列
patterns.context: 与 Scotland 并列，作为国家或地区名称出现；激活强度低于 Scotland

patterns.name: 英国相关修饰语
patterns.context: 修饰 Bishops、Sculptors 等机构或身份名词

patterns.name: 英伦群岛地域词
patterns.context: 与苏格兰历史或地理叙述相邻，涉及城市、方位、岛屿或高地
patterns.domain: 历史、地理、医疗服务百科

patterns.name: 爱尔兰／苏格兰历史人物名
patterns.context: 出现在早期基督教传入苏格兰及周边地区的叙述中

patterns.name: 文学标题中的苏格兰
patterns.context: Scotland 嵌在作品标题中，涉及1746年及讽刺诗目录

patterns.name: 苏格兰地名相关词形
patterns.context: 苏格兰作为政府所属地或气候法案归属地出现

patterns.name: 英国货币与人均支出比较
patterns.context: 货币符号出现在英格兰、威尔士、苏格兰的人均公共支出对比中

patterns.name: 异质强激活触发词
patterns.context: 金额数字紧随英镑符号；具体触发边界可能包括货币符号及其后数字

en.description: All passages strongly activate on names for Scotland, primarily «Scotland» and also «Scottish». They appear in varied contexts, including country comparisons, history and culture, public policy, medicine, and place descriptions.

patterns.name: Lists and comparisons of countries or regions
patterns.context: Scotland is mentioned in comparisons of countries, regions, populations, or spending; also includes use alongside other UK regions.
patterns.domain: Country profiles, news commentary, public finance

patterns.name: British historical and cultural contexts
patterns.context: Scotland appears as a historical, cultural, or kingdom/national identity, including “Scotland” in poem titles and the adjective “Scottish.”

patterns.name: Scotland in modern public affairs
patterns.context: Concerns Scottish governance, environmental legislation, public services, or health policy.
patterns.domain: News, government and public policy, medical research

patterns.name: Scotland as a location or service region
patterns.context: A place phrase identifies where a person works or is active, or describes a service covering Scotland and its remote areas.
patterns.domain: Sports biographies, geography and healthcare service encyclopedias

0_2596.description: 所有段都强烈激活于苏格兰名称：主要是«Scotland»，另有«Scottish»；出现于国家比较、历史文化、公共政策、医疗及地点介绍等多种语境。

patterns.name: 国家或地区名称列表与比较
patterns.trigger: «Scotland»10；同段还出现« England»9、« Ireland»9、« Germany»8、« countries»2；另有« Wales»6
patterns.context: 在国家、地区或人口／支出比较中提及苏格兰；也包括与其他英国地区并列的用法
patterns.domain: 国家介绍、新闻评论、公共财政

patterns.name: 英国历史与文化语境
patterns.context: 苏格兰作为历史、文化或王国／国家身份出现，包括诗歌标题中的“Scotland”及“Scottish”形容词
patterns.domain: 历史讲座、文学目录、人物传记

patterns.name: 现代公共事务中的苏格兰
patterns.trigger: «Scotland»10；« Scottish»6；« Climate»3 Change« Bill»1、« parliament»3、« NHS»2
patterns.context: 涉及苏格兰的治理、环境立法、公共服务或卫生政策
patterns.domain: 新闻、政府与公共政策、医学研究

patterns.name: 苏格兰作为地点或服务区域
patterns.context: 地点短语中指出人物任职或活动所在地，或描述覆盖苏格兰及其偏远地区的服务
patterns.domain: 体育人物介绍、地理与医疗服务百科

en.description: All passages contain Scotland, which activates strongly across historical, literary, news, policy, statistical, and biographical accounts. Scottish also activates; there are a few weaker activations in lists of UK regions, statistical expressions, and Highland and island contexts.

patterns.name: Place name Scotland
patterns.context: Scotland appears in contexts involving Scottish places, history, literature, policy, statistics, and institutions; this is the strongest trigger.
patterns.domain: British geography, history, literature, and public affairs

patterns.name: Scotland-related adjective
patterns.context: Modifies nouns related to Scotland, such as government.

patterns.name: Names of constituent UK regions
patterns.context: Appears alongside Scotland in discussions of national or regional representation; England activates more strongly, while the other terms are weaker.

patterns.name: Comparisons among UK regions
patterns.context: Public spending is compared by region, with regional names occurring alongside repeated expressions of quantity allocation.

patterns.name: Unclear place-name-related triggers
patterns.context: Appears in accounts of healthcare services in the Scottish Highlands and islands and in remote areas, but Scotland itself remains the strongest unmarked trigger; whether these words trigger independently is uncertain.

0_2596.description: 所有段落都包含 Scotland；其在各类历史、文学、新闻、政策、统计和人物叙述中均强烈激活。Scottish 也激活，另有少量英国地区并列、统计表达及高地岛屿语境中的弱激活。

patterns.name: 苏格兰地名
patterns.context: 出现苏格兰或涉及苏格兰的地名、历史、文学、政策、统计及机构等语境；触发强度最高。
patterns.domain: 英国地理、历史、文学及公共事务

patterns.name: 苏格兰相关形容词
patterns.context: 修饰政府等与苏格兰相关的名词。

patterns.name: 英国构成地区名称
patterns.context: 与苏格兰并列，讨论国家或地区代表性；其中 England 的激活较强，其他词较弱。

patterns.name: 英国地区间比较
patterns.context: 按地区比较公共支出，地区名与重复的数量分配表达共同出现。

patterns.name: 不明确的地名相关触发
patterns.context: 出现在苏格兰高地与岛屿医疗服务、偏远地区的叙述中，但未标出的 Scotland 仍是最强触发；这些词是否独立触发不确定。

en.description: All snippets contain «malignancies» in a medical context, involving its complications, immune-related diseases, cancer types and sites, incidence, and treatment; the most direct and consistent trigger is the word itself.

patterns.name: Malignancy-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Activates in medical texts describing malignancies, cancer, epidemiology, classification, associated diseases, or treatment; appears in multiple grammatical positions, including as a plural noun and in modifying contexts.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers (oncology, immunology, epidemiology, and treatment)

0_2796.description: 所有片段均在医学语境中出现 «malignancies»，涉及其并发症、免疫相关疾病、癌种与部位、发病情况及治疗；最直接且一致的触发是该词本身。

patterns.name: 恶性肿瘤相关词汇
patterns.context: 医学文本中描述恶性肿瘤、癌症或其流行病学、分类、伴随疾病及治疗时激活；在多个语法位置出现，包括复数名词及修饰语境。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文（肿瘤学、免疫学、流行病学及治疗）

en.description: All passages activate on “malignancies” in medical papers; surrounding contexts cover tumor classification, sites, epidemiology, related diseases, differential diagnosis, and treatment.

patterns.name: The entity term “malignancies”
patterns.context: Appears as a disease noun in medical contexts; may refer to malignancies at a particular site, of a particular type, or associated with other conditions.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, especially oncology, pathology, and clinical medicine

patterns.name: Medical co-occurrence terms and local associations
patterns.context: Medical expressions adjacent to or semantically associated with tumors, malignancies, their sites, classification, incidence, or treatment; activation remains focused mainly on “malignancies”.

patterns.name: Malignancies listed in differential diagnoses
patterns.context: “Malignancies” is listed alongside infections, inflammatory diseases, or other comorbidities as an item in a differential diagnosis or disease list.
patterns.domain: Clinical case reports and medical reviews

0_2796.description: 所有段落都激活于医学论文中的“malignancies”；周围上下文涵盖肿瘤分类、部位、流行病学、相关疾病、鉴别诊断及治疗。

patterns.name: 实体词“malignancies”
patterns.context: 在医学语境中，作为疾病名词出现；可指某部位、某类或与其他病症相关的恶性肿瘤。
patterns.domain: 医学论文，尤其是肿瘤学、病理学和临床医学

patterns.name: 医学共现词及局部关联
